The tolerance percentage is too high.

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A client is implementing accounts receivable in Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
You need to identify which requirements can be fulfilled by configuring the customer posting profile.  
  
Which three requirements can be fulfilled? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Specifying a receivable account for certain customers
Setting an interest code for a group of customers
Specifying a revenue account for sales orders transactions
Setting terms of payment for a group of customers
Setting the liquidity ledger account used for cash flow forecast

questions.explanation:
A customer posting profile can be assigned at the individual-customer or customer-group level and specifies the accounts receivable summary account, an interest code for associated customers, and the liquidity ledger account used in cash-flow forecasts. Sales-order revenue accounts are configured through inventory posting setup, while payment terms are maintained independently of the customer posting profile.

**Learn more:** [Customer posting profiles - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/customer-posting-profiles) · [Cash flow forecasting - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/cash-bank-management/cash-flow-forecasting)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance to administer customer support contracts.  
  
You need to validate a customer's revenue recognition schedule.  
  
On which two pages can you view the revenue recognition schedule? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
After a sales order invoice is posted, Finance creates revenue recognition schedules for applicable sales-order lines. The schedule details can be opened directly from an invoiced sales order, or from the **Revenue recognition schedule** page under **Revenue recognition > Periodic tasks**.

**Learn more:** [Recognize deferred revenue - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/revenue-recognition-recognize-deferred-revenue)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have deployed Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
You must change the fiscal year to a 4-4-5 quarterly configuration.  
  
You need to configure the fiscal year.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Set up the length of the period to 1 year and divide the period according to the quarterly configuration.
Configure the period length to 12 months and adjust the ending date of each period.
Configure the period length to 1 year and adjust the ending date of each period.
Set up the length of the period to 13 months.

questions.explanation:
A 4-4-5 fiscal calendar requires a one-year fiscal period to be divided into variable-length periods of four, four, and five weeks for each quarter. Dynamics 365 Finance supports dividing existing fiscal periods, whereas setting a 12-month or 13-month period length does not establish the 4-4-5 pattern.

**Learn more:** [Fiscal calendars, fiscal years, and periods - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/fiscal-calendars-fiscal-years-periods)

questions.question:
A public-sector organization is setting up encumbrance processing to manage capital budgets. The finance department must configure posting definitions for bank transactions. You need to configure Dynamics 365 Finance for cash settlements.  
  
What should you do?
questions.explanation:
Pooled cash accounting uses amounts deposited by individual funds into a combined ledger account. For cash settlements, posting definitions are configured in the **Bank** module and associated with the applicable vendor or customer payment transaction types so that due-to and due-from entries balance settlement vouchers by fund.\
\
**Learn more:** [Posting definitions in the public sector - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/public-sector/posting-definitions-public-sector)

questions.question:
A public-sector organization is setting up encumbrance processing to manage capital budgets. The finance department must configure posting definitions for bank transactions. You need to configure Dynamics 365 Finance for cash settlements.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Configure inventory posting profiles individually for each vendor.
Assign posting profiles at the global level.
Assign posting profiles based on item groups and transaction types.
Configure posting profiles to use different ledger accounts for physical and financial updates.

questions.explanation:
Inventory posting profiles are maintained per legal entity and use item groups and posting transaction types to determine the applicable ledger accounts. Purchase-order receipts are physical updates, while invoices are financial updates; separate ledger accounts can be configured for those physical and financial posting types.

**Learn more:** [Purchase order posting - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/purchase-order-posting) · [Physical and financial updates - Supply Chain Management | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/physical-financial-updates)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Ensure that User9’s purchase is recorded correctly.  
  
Which three actions should you take? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Select a fixed asset group at the line level.
Set the new fixed asset toggle to yes at the line level.
Enter three purchase order lines, enter quantity of 1.
Enter one purchase order line, enter quantity of 3.
Select a financial dimension at the line level.

questions.explanation:
To create fixed assets from a purchase order, the purchase line must be marked as a new fixed asset and assigned a fixed asset group. One purchase order line creates one fixed asset regardless of the quantity on that line; therefore, recording three individual assets requires three lines, each with a quantity of 1.

A company intends to allocate revenue across occurrences by using a recognition basis.  
  
Which recognition basis can be used?

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You use Dynamics 365 Finance. Your company provides cash discounts. The discounts are offered sequentially to particular customers. Customers must pay their invoices within a specified period. The cash discounts are:  
  
- 5D10% - A cash discount of 10 percent if the amount is paid within 5 days.  
- 10D5% - A cash discount of 5 percent if the amount is paid within 10 days.  
- 14D2% - A cash discount of 2 percent if the amount is paid within 14 days.  
  
Cash discounts can be granted only when payments are made within 10 days.  
  
You need to configure cash discounts.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create a new cash discount code of 14D10%.
Create a new cash discount code of 10D14%.
Delete the 14D2% cash discount code from the next discount code list value of 10D5%.

questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Finance uses the **Next discount code** field to make cash-discount tiers succeed one another after the prior discount date expires. Removing 14D2% from the Next discount code value for 10D5% ends this sequence at the 10-day tier, so a discount cannot be granted after 10 days while retaining the 14D2% code for any other use.

**Learn more:** [Cash discounts - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/cash-bank-management/cash-discounts)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure two account structures: one for expense accounts that includes the applicable dimensions, and one for balance-sheet accounts that excludes financial dimensions.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
In Dynamics 365 Finance, account structures define the financial-dimension segments available and whether their values are required for particular main accounts. Using an expense-account structure that includes the applicable dimensions and a balance-sheet-account structure containing no financial-dimension segments makes dimensions required only for expense postings and unavailable for balance-sheet postings.\
\
**Learn more:** [Financial dimensions and posting - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/default-dimensions)

questions.question:
Solution: Set up one account structure for expense accounts and apply advanced rules.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Advanced rules add financial-dimension segments to an account structure when specified criteria are met; they do not remove the dimensions defined by the account structure. To make dimensions available only for expense main accounts while preventing their selection for balance sheet main accounts, balance sheet accounts require an applicable main-account-only account structure. A single expense-account structure with advanced rules does not supply that configuration.\
\
**Learn more:** [Financial dimensions and posting - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/default-dimensions) · [Create and assign advanced rule structures - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/create-assign-advanced-rule-structures)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
Solution: Set up one account structure for expense accounts and include the applicable dimensions.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
An account structure defines the valid account and financial-dimension combinations for ledger posting. Configuring only an expense-account structure with dimensions leaves balance-sheet accounts without an applicable structure; balance-sheet accounts require a separate structure containing only the main account so users can post to them without being offered financial dimensions. [Financial dimensions and posting — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/default-dimensions)\
\
**Learn more:** [Financial dimensions and posting — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/default-dimensions)

questions.question:
Solution: Set up default financial dimensions only on expense accounts.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Default financial dimensions merely provide dimension values; they do not determine which financial-dimension segments are available for a selected main account. An account structure controls the dimensions applicable to main-account ranges and whether those dimensions are required. Therefore, defaulting dimensions only on expense accounts does not prevent users from selecting dimensions for balance sheet accounts.\
\
**Learn more:** [Financial dimensions and posting - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/default-dimensions)

You use Dynamics 365 Finance for day-to-day bank reconciliation.  
  
You must use the BAI2 bank statement format.  
  
You need to configure the bank statement import format for the bank reconciliation process.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Import the bank statement as a template for the bank statement format.
Set up a batch job to import the bank statement.
Set up an import project for the bank statement in a Data management workspace using files provided by Microsoft.
Set up a journal name to import a bank statement transaction.

questions.explanation:
BAI2 bank statement import is configured by creating an import project in the Data management workspace, using the Bank statements entity and Microsoft-provided sample and transformation files. This establishes the format processing group that is subsequently assigned to the BAI2 bank statement format.

**Learn more:** [Set up the advanced bank reconciliation import process](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/cash-bank-management/set-up-advanced-bank-reconciliation-import-process)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
A company uses Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and sells one of its assets.  
  
You need to dispose of the asset in the system.  
  
Which transaction type should you use?
questions.explanation:
A fixed asset sold to a customer is disposed of by using the **Disposal - sale** transaction type. This transaction type records the asset’s disposal value and supports using a customer account for the sale proceeds.\
\
**Learn more:** [Fixed asset disposal posting accounts — Finance | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/fixed-assets/fixed-asset-disposal-posting-accounts) · [Fixed asset transaction options — Finance | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/fixed-assets/enter-fixed-asset-transactions)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company is using Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
You need to reclassify a fixed asset.  
  
Which three actions does the system take when an asset is reclassified? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: The system will generate reclassification journals.
The new books of the new fixed asset contain the date of the reclassification in the Acquisition date field.
All books for the existing fixed asset are created for the new fixed asset.
The existing fixed asset transactions for the original fixed asset are canceled and regenerated for the new fixed asset.
The new fixed asset only cancels out possible depreciations because the reclassification date is filled in in the Acquisition date field.

questions.explanation:
When a fixed asset is reclassified, Dynamics 365 Finance creates all existing asset books for the new asset, records the reclassification date in each new book’s Acquisition date field, and cancels and regenerates the original asset’s fixed-asset transactions for the new asset.

**Learn more:** [Reclassify fixed assets - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/fixed-assets/tasks/reclassify-fixed-assets)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A client has a single legal entity and these four configured dimensions: Business Unit, Cost Center, Department, and Division.  
  
You need to configure the client’s system so the **Trial balance** inquiry in the General ledger module displays the trial balance in two ways:  
  
- Include the main account and all four dimensions.  
- Include the main account and only the Business Unit and Cost Center dimensions.  
  
What should you configure?

options.text: all financial dimensions by using the group dimension functionality

questions.explanation:
A financial dimension set is an ordered list of financial dimensions used to summarize General ledger data, and a primary use of a dimension set is defining a trial balance. One set can include the main account and all four dimensions, while a second set can include the main account, Business Unit, and Cost Center only.

**Learn more:** [Financial dimension sets - Finance | Dynamics 365 | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/financial-dimension-sets)

questions.question:
You need to configure system functionality for reporting by pickle type.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
Financial dimensions categorize financial transactions with dimension values, enabling financial statements and other financial analysis to be reported by a business-specific attribute such as pickle type. Item model groups control inventory behavior, item groups support inventory grouping and posting, and procurement categories classify purchasing rather than provide a general-ledger reporting segment.\
\
**Learn more:** [Financial dimensions and tags - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/financial-dimensions)

questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
All customer balances must post to an accounts receivable trading main account.  
  
You need to configure the customer posting profile.  
  
Which posting-profile field value should you use?
questions.explanation:
The **Summary account** field specifies the main account used for the Customer balance posting type, including the Accounts receivable Trade account for customers associated with the posting profile.\
\
**Learn more:** [Customer posting profiles - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/customer-posting-profiles)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
You are setting up intercompany accounting for a multicompany enterprise.  
  
You must configure the Due to and Due from accounts. Which main account type should you use?
questions.explanation:
Due to and Due from accounts record intercompany receivable and payable balances and must be configured with the **Balance sheet** main account type. Microsoft’s intercompany accounting setup guidance explicitly requires this type for the main accounts used for these entries.\
\
**Learn more:** [Intercompany accounting setup - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/intercompany-accounting-setup)

questions.question:
You need to ensure that the budget reflects only one annual cost-of-living increase for Humongous Insurance employees.  
  
What should you do? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Align the calendar year to a single budget cycle.
Align a calendar year to multiple budget cycles.
Align the fiscal year to a single budget cycle.
Align the fiscal year to multiple budget cycles.

questions.explanation:
Position forecasting creates one annual increase per calendar year, and it creates multiple increases when a budget cycle includes multiple calendar years. Aligning one calendar year with one budget cycle ensures that the budget cycle contains only one calendar year and therefore only one annual increase.\
\
**Learn more:** [Position forecasting - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/position-forecasting)

questions.question:
Solution: Define a budget model. Set the active forecasting process to the current-year forecast.  
  
Does the solution achieve the goal?
questions.explanation:
A budget model and an active forecasting process do not by themselves configure the workspace’s unfavorable-variance views. The Ledger budgets and forecasts workspace must be configured with the applicable organization hierarchy and budget-threshold settings to identify expenses over budget and revenue under budget. Actual-versus-budget reporting provides expense and revenue budget goals, but those workspace-specific settings determine which variances are highlighted.\
\
**Learn more:** [Actual vs budget Power BI content - Finance & Operations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/fin-ops-core/dev-itpro/analytics/ledger-budgets-power-bi)

questions.question:
Solution: In the **Configure my workspace** form, select an organization hierarchy. Set an expense budget threshold percentage.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
The Ledger budgets and forecasts workspace provides **Expense over budget** and **Revenue under budget** views for financial-dimension combinations whose budget targets are not met or are nearing the configured threshold. An organization hierarchy scopes the relevant organizational data, and an expense budget threshold percentage determines when expense variances are highlighted.\
\
**Learn more:** [Budget control overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-control-overview-configuration)

questions.question:
Solution: On the **Configure my workspace** form, set values for the expense dimension set, expense budget threshold, revenue dimension set, and revenue budget threshold percent fields.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
The Ledger budgets and forecasts workspace identifies expense combinations that exceed the expense budget threshold and revenue combinations that fall below the revenue threshold. Configuring the expense and revenue dimension sets together with their respective threshold values personalizes those two workspace views for budget-versus-actual monitoring.\
\
**Learn more:** [Budget control overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-control-overview-configuration)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
Solution: Configure an expense dimension set. Set the **Show amounts** field value for the set to **Per budget cycle**.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
An expense dimension set supports expense budget-versus-actual analysis only. Tracking revenue under budget also requires a revenue dimension set; setting **Show amounts** to **Per budget cycle** only determines the aggregation period and does not configure revenue reporting.\
\
**Learn more:** [Budget control overview - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-control-overview-configuration)

questions.domain: Implement and manage accounts payable and expenses
questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
The company has chosen to implement basic budgeting to monitor budgeted amounts versus actual amounts.  
  
You need to configure the system to track and identify budget transactions and establish controls over budget balance updates.  
  
What should you define?

options.text: Number sequence for budget register entries

questions.explanation: In Dynamics 365 Finance basic budgeting, number sequences must be defined for budget register entries. This numbering scheme allows each budget register entry to be tracked and identified as a unique document, and it establishes control over who can enter, view, or change the budget amounts recorded in that entry, satisfying the requirement to track budget transactions and control updates to budget balances.

questions.question:

Which settings should you use?

/>","className":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses the basic budgeting capabilities in Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
You need to create budget register entries.  
  
What are three possible ways to accomplish this goal?  
  
Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Use a periodic batch job to automatically prepare budget data on a recurring basis.
Use the Create Budget Allocation rules page to generate periodic budget register entries.
Use the Microsoft Office add-in on the Budget register entry page.
Manually enter the budget information on the Budget register entry page.
Import budget register entries by using the Data management page.

questions.explanation:
Budget register entries can be created by entering the budget information directly on the Budget register entry page, by using its Microsoft Office add-in, or by importing budget register-entry data through Data management. Budget allocation functionality allocates an existing budget register entry across periods or financial dimensions; it is not a periodic-entry generation mechanism.

**Learn more:** [Create budget register entries - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-register-entries)

questions.question:
You are the accounts receivable manager for an organization. The organization has recently sold machinery to a customer.  
  
You need to record the machinery sale by using a free text invoice for fixed assets. Which transaction type should you use?
questions.explanation:
A sale of a fixed asset through an Accounts receivable free text invoice is posted as a disposal transaction. Dynamics 365 Finance specifies that the fixed asset transaction type for free text invoices is always **Disposal - sale**.\
\
**Learn more:** [Fixed asset transaction options — Dynamics 365 Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/fixed-assets/enter-fixed-asset-transactions)

questions.domain: Implement and manage accounts payable and expenses

options.text: Net0 or due on invoice date term of payment and a 60-90-120 payment schedule
Net90 term of payment and a 30-60-90 payment schedule
Net60 term of payment and a 30-60-90 payment schedule
Net120 term of payment and a 60-90-120 payment schedule

questions.explanation:
When a payment schedule is linked to terms of payment, the terms determine the due date of the first installment, and the payment schedule determines the due dates of later installments. A Net60 term sets the first equal payment 60 days after the invoice date; a 30-60-90 payment schedule produces the later payments at 90 and 120 days.

**Learn more:** [Define vendor payment terms - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-payable/tasks/define-vendor-payment-terms) · [Apply a payment schedule to the invoice journal - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-payable/payment-invoice-journal)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are setting up vendor collaboration security roles for external vendors. You manually create a vendor contact.  
  
You need to assign this vendor the **Vendor (external)** role. Which tasks can the vendor perform?

options.text: Request a new user account for a contact person by using the Provision user action.
Delete any contact person that they have created.
View and modify contact person information, such as the person's title, email address, and telephone number.

questions.explanation:
The **Vendor (external)** role permits an external vendor to maintain vendor collaboration invoices. Managing contact-person details, deleting contacts, and requesting user provisioning require the **Vendor admin (external)** role.

**Learn more:** [Set up and maintain vendor collaboration](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/set-up-maintain-vendor-collaboration) · [Manage vendor collaboration users](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/manage-vendor-collaboration-users)

questions.domain: Implement and manage accounts payable and expenses
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],The controller at a company has multiple employees who create standard General ledger journals. The controller wants to review those journal entries before they are posted. At present, journal entries are posted without review.  
  
You need to configure Dynamics 365 Finance to establish a system-led review process that meets the controller’s needs.  
  
Which functionality should you configure?

options.text: signing limit policies with the controller assigned to the appropriate signing limit band
a Ledger daily journal workflow that uses the organizational hierarchy for journal posting, associated with the General ledger journal name
an Advanced ledger entry workflow that uses the organizational hierarchy for journal posting, associated with the Advanced ledger journal name
an alert that is sent to the controller when a journal name is created

questions.explanation:
A Ledger daily journal workflow associated with the General ledger journal name enforces an approval process for standard General ledger journals before posting. Its workflow approvals can use the organizational hierarchy to route the journal to the appropriate reviewer, such as the controller. Microsoft documents that journal workflows are configured for general journals through General ledger workflows and provide review and approval controls.

**Learn more:** [General journal processing - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/general-journal-processing)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
You are implementing Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
You frequently complete sales of goods across international borders.  
  
You must configure the system.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
Letters of credit are bank documents used for international transactions involving the purchase and sale of goods. In Dynamics 365 Finance, they support import and export processing and help guarantee payment when the agreed terms are met.\
\
**Learn more:** [Letters of credit and import collections - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/cash-bank-management/letters-of-credit-import-collections) · [Set up bank facilities and posting profiles for letter of credit - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/cash-bank-management/tasks/set-up-bank-facilities-posting-profiles-letter-credit)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
You are implementing Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
You frequently complete sales of goods across international borders.  
  
You must configure the system.  
  
What should you use?

options.text: Assign 21D2% as the next discount code for 7D10%.
Assign 14D5% as the next discount code for 7D10%.
Assign 21D2% as the next discount code for 14D5%.

questions.explanation:
A tiered cash-discount setup begins with the earliest discount code on the customer account. The Next discount code field chains each later, lower discount after the preceding discount period expires. Thus, 7D10% is the customer cash discount, 14D5% follows 7D10%, and 21D2% follows 14D5%.

**Learn more:** [Cash discounts - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/cash-bank-management/cash-discounts)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Finance to manage billing schedules. The company intends to create recurring invoices by using a recurring batch process.  
  
The company must include billing schedule lines with a start date through November 1. The current month is July.  
  
You need to configure the **Date range** filter on the **Generate invoice batch processing** page.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Select Months and set the number of months to 5.
Select Days and set the number of days to 0.
Select Months and set the number of months to 4.

questions.explanation:
For the Generate invoice batch-processing Date range filter, the current month is included when Months is selected. Microsoft’s example uses two months in January to include billing schedule lines through March 1; therefore, from July, four months includes lines through November 1.

**Learn more:** [Periodic tasks in Recurring contract billing - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/sb-periodic-tasks)

questions.domain: Implement and manage accounts payable and expenses
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You must configure the regional distribution centers.  
  
Which three actions should you take? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Associate the financial dimension to the site
Associate the legal entity to the site

questions.explanation:
A distribution center is configured as a site. Site-based financial tracking requires a financial dimension to be configured and linked to the site; the linked financial-dimension value is assigned for each site. In Supply Chain Management, a site belongs to a single legal entity, so creating or associating a legal entity is not required for this configuration.

**Learn more:** [Configure and manage financial dimension links to sites](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/financial-dimension-links) · [Define the organizational structure in Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/guidance/organizational-strategy/define-organizational-strategy)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company intends to create a new allocation rule for electric-utilities expenses.  
  
The allocation rule must satisfy the following requirements:  
  
- Allocate overhead utility expense to every department.  
- Specify how, and in what proportion, the source amounts must be allocated across the various destination lines.  
  
You need to configure the allocation rule.  
  
Which allocation method should you use?

options.text: Distribute the source document amount equally

questions.explanation:
The Fixed weight method assigns a defined weight to each destination line and allocates the source amount according to the relative weights. It therefore supports distributing utility overhead among departments in specified proportions. The Basis method is used when proportions must be calculated from actual ledger balances, and Equally assigns the same share to every destination.

**Learn more:** [Ledger allocation rules - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/ledger-allocation-rules)

questions.domain: Implement and manage accounts payable and expenses
questions.question:
You must configure settings to resolve User8's issue.  
  
What should you select?

options.text: a main account in the sales tax payable field
a main account in the settlement account field

questions.explanation:
Conditional sales tax is paid to the tax authority proportionally when an invoice payment is posted, rather than when the invoice is posted. Selecting the Conditional sales tax setting enables this behavior; ledger posting-group accounts do not change the tax-recognition timing.\
\
**Learn more:** [Sales tax overview - Finance | Dynamics 365 | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/indirect-taxes-overview)

A multinational corporation is headquartered in the United States and has subsidiaries in Canada and Spain.  
  
The corporation requires consolidated reports for its European parent organization. Its accounting currency is USD, and its reporting currency is EUR.  
  
The corporation must automate gain-and-loss calculations for the EUR reporting currency during ledger settlements to streamline the period-end closing process.  
  
For the Spanish subsidiary, local regulations require checks to include the currency gender. In this context, EUR is feminine.  
  
You need to configure the system.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Configure a default currency override for the Spanish subsidiary to use USD for all transactions.
Disable gain and loss calculations for the reporting currency during ledger settlement.
Configure the currency gender of EUR as Feminine for the Spanish legal entity.
Set the accounting currency to USD and the reporting currency to EUR in the corporation ledger setup.

questions.explanation:
The ledger configuration must set USD as the accounting currency and EUR as the reporting currency. Ledger settlement can post realized gain or loss when accounting or reporting currency amounts differ, supporting automated reporting-currency settlement adjustments. The stated Spanish localization requirement also requires EUR to be configured with Feminine currency gender for check wording.

**Learn more:** [Ledger settlements - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/ledger-settlements) · [How to change the accounting or reporting currency - Dynamics 365 Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/dynamics-365/finance/general-ledger/add-change-accounting-reporting-currency)

You need to configure fiscal calendars for Dynamics 365 Finance.

**Background**

Tailspin Toys is a toy manufacturing company that sells to distributors and customers through a business-to-consumer website. Tailspin Toys has been using custom-developed software for accounting and supply chain management needs.

Tailspin Toys has toy factories in Mexico and Canada, with a head office in the United States. Tailspin Toys is currently operating with multiple financial departments, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, and general accounting. The company has several legal entities to support its manufacturing units and selling organization.

Tailspin Toys wants to sustain steady growth as a company and is now implementing Dynamics 365 Finance for all business processes.

**Current environment**

**Vendors**

- Tailspin Toys works with local and foreign vendors.
- The procurement process is designed for manufacturing raw materials, finished products, and packing materials for toys.
- The company monitors vendor balances by local and foreign vendors, with both appearing in different general ledger accounts.
- For vendor payments, the accounts payable manager generates payment proposals every Wednesday, so approvals and check printing are completed by Thursday in order to mail the checks by Friday of each week.
- Vendors can participate in the incentive program that offers travel vouchers and other gifts based on the quantity and quality of supplies at year-end.
- Incentive program data is being tracked outside of the system, and qualifying vendors are then provided to the financial department for expenses.
- The finance department accrues a small percentage of every vendor invoice during the year for this purpose, booking the accounts payable liability account and offsetting it to the incentive expenses account.
- The finance department accrual then enables management to easily decide what types of gifts and vouchers to provide to the top-performing vendors.

**Reporting**

- Management receives periodic reports from the finance department for all legal entities. These reports provide all required finance data and include balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements.

**Budget planning**

- The finance department manages all budget planning.
- The finance department estimates the baseline for all budgets and distributes them to the respective departments.
- Each department estimates and forecasts its budget and sends it back to the finance department, where the budget is updated accordingly.

**Expenses**

Utility bills for the toy factories are currently expensed to the following departments as per the listed breakdown.

![Scenario Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1784085758741-xb55i98b.png)

**Asset leasing**

Tailspin Toys has leased assets in the form of factory buildings and warehouses. The company maintains asset books for the monthly leasing payments and pays compound interest on them. Tailspin Toys maintains future forecasts of its payment projections and budget requirements for leasing payments.

**Requirements**

**Consolidation**

- Automatic foreign currency consolidation at the corporate level is required by Tailspin Toys’ leadership.
- Consolidated results are needed in multiple reporting currencies.

**Expenses**

- Utility bills must be allocated so that each department expenses the correct amount.

**Reports**

- Leadership requires financial reports to be delivered to their inbox automatically as one at the end of every month.

**Vendors**

- The system must show accounts payable liability by type of vendor similar to how it works in the current system.
- The chief financial officer (CFO) wants to configure the system to follow their business policies of paying vendors every Friday and according to credit issued by vendors and the agreed method of payments.
- The accounts payable administrator must automate the vendor invoice process for imported invoices to bypass the review stage when no discrepancy is determined.

**Budgets**

- A new organizational hierarchy is required for budget planning purposes.
- Leadership wants financial budgets enforced by alerting users when 90% of the total budget is reached.

**Asset leasing**

- The CFO must automatically process payments and journal entries for the leased properties.
- Management must view payment forecasts based on leased assets.

**Issues**

**Accounts payable issues**

- Vendor liability information for local and foreign vendors is not separated in the system.
- The accounts payable manager observed that a percentage of each invoice paid to vendors is not being posted for the yearly incentives program.
- The accounts payable clerk had to manually invoice a vendor receipt during user acceptance testing.
- The accounts payable manager must automate the current process of vendor payment proposals.

**Other issues**

- The differences resulting from consolidating subsidiaries with foreign currencies are not considered.
- User A confirmed they did not receive an alert before running out of their budget.
- Expense reports for the manufacturing and sales departments do not contain utility bill expenses.

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],The controller at a company has several employees who enter standard General ledger journals. The controller wants to review these journal entries before they are posted. Currently, journal entries are posted without review.  
  
You need to configure Dynamics 365 Finance to help establish a system-led review process that meets the controller's needs.  
  
Which functionality should you configure?

options.text: a Ledger daily journal workflow that uses the organizational hierarchy for journal posting, associated with the General ledger journal name
a saved query in the Voucher inquiries form for the controller to view all general journals posted to the ledger
a manual journal approval with the journal assigned to the user group that the employees are assigned to
the controller's security rote so that he has approval privileges for General ledger journals

questions.explanation:
A Ledger daily journal workflow associated with the General ledger journal name routes journal entries through review and approval before posting, providing the required internal control. Microsoft documents workflow approval on journal names as the mechanism for review and approval steps for general journals.

**Learn more:** [General journal processing - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/general-journal-processing)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Solution:  
  
- Set **Enable invoice matching validation** to **Yes**.  
- Set **Post invoices with discrepancies** to **Require approval**.  
- Add a vendor invoice policy so that the new vendor invoice is reviewed.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Invoice matching validation and requiring approval for posting apply to matching discrepancies between invoice, purchase order, and product receipt data. They do not identify vendors that are within their first 12 months. Vendor invoice policies can evaluate policy violations, but additional approvals for newly created vendors require a vendor invoice workflow condition and approval configuration based on the vendor’s age or creation date.

**Learn more:** [Accounts payable invoice matching overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-payable/accounts-payable-invoice-matching) · [Set up vendor invoice policies](https://learn.microsoft.com/ga-ie/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/tasks/set-up-vendor-invoice-policies)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Solution:  
  
- Set **Enable invoice matching validation** to **Yes**.  
- Set **Post invoices with discrepancies** to **Allow warning**.  
- Create a workflow approval with an automatic action that approves all invoices not matching a specified vendor identification list.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Invoice matching validation and posting-discrepancy settings govern invoice matching exceptions, not approval requirements based on how long a vendor has been active. Automatically approving invoices outside a vendor identification list bypasses approval for those invoices and does not configure additional approval for invoices from vendors within their first 12 months. Vendor invoice policies and workflow criteria must target the new-vendor condition so those invoices are routed for the required extra approval.

**Learn more:** [Set up vendor invoice policies - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/tasks/set-up-vendor-invoice-policies) · [Accounts payable invoice matching overview - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-payable/accounts-payable-invoice-matching)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Solution:  
  
- Set **Enable invoice matching validation** to **Yes**.  
- Set **Post invoices with discrepancies** to **Allow with warning**.  
- Add a vendor invoice policy so the new vendor invoice is reviewed.  
  
Does this solution achieve the goal?
questions.explanation:
Invoice matching validation compares vendor invoices with purchase orders and product receipts; it does not enforce an approval based on how long the vendor has existed. Allowing invoices with discrepancies to post with a warning does not require approval. A workflow or policy configuration that explicitly requires approval for invoices from vendors within their first 12 months is necessary.

**Learn more:** [Set up vendor invoice policies - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/ga-ie/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/tasks/set-up-vendor-invoice-policies) · [Accounts payable invoice matching overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-payable/accounts-payable-invoice-matching)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Solution:  
  
Set **Enable invoice matching validation** to **No**.  
  
Create a workflow approval with an automatic action that approves all invoices that do not match a specified vendor identification list.  
  
Does the solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A vendor invoice workflow can automate approval for invoices that satisfy defined criteria while routing the remaining invoices for authorized review. Configuring automatic approval only for vendors outside the designated list leaves invoices from vendors on the new-vendor list subject to the additional approval. Invoice matching validation is separate from vendor-based workflow routing.

**Learn more:** [Accounts payable home page – Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-payable/accounts-payable) · [Accounts payable invoice matching overview – Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-payable/accounts-payable-invoice-matching)

What should you do?

options.text: Use the audit list search query type.
Set up the aggregate query type for entertainment expenses.

Add more keywords to the audit policy.

questions.explanation:

Adding relevant keywords broadens the policy’s matching criteria so entertainment expenses described with additional terms are identified for audit, whereas aggregate, sampling, and list-search query types serve different purposes.\

**Learn more:** [Audit policy rules - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/audit-policy-rules)

options.text: an Advanced ledger entry workflow that uses the organizational hierarchy for journal posting, associated with the Advanced ledger journal name
an alert that is sent to the controller when a journal name is created
a Ledger daily journal workflow that uses the organizational hierarchy for journal posting, associated with the General ledger journal name
signing limit policies with the controller when a journal name is created

questions.explanation:
The Ledger daily journal workflow provides approval control for standard General ledger journals. When it is associated with the General ledger journal name and configured to assign approval through the organizational hierarchy, journal entries must be reviewed and approved before they can be posted. Microsoft documents that journal workflows for general journals establish review and approval steps as an internal control.

**Learn more:** [General journal processing - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/general-journal-processing)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company is implementing basic budgeting functionality in Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
Budget managers must receive notification of a budget register posting task after a finance director approves an entry.  
  
You need to configure the system.  
  
Which workflow element should be used?
questions.explanation:
The **Update budget balances budget register** workflow element creates the automated task that updates budget balances, which is the budget-register posting activity that follows approval. Budget register entries are submitted to workflows configured for their budget code, and updating budget balances is the action used to record the entry’s budget amounts.

**Learn more:** [Create budget register entries - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-register-entries)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],HOTSPOT —  
  
You must ensure that Trey Research satisfies the compliance requirement.  
  
Which budget technology should you implement? Each correct answer represents a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Budgeting workflows route budget register entries through defined review and approval steps, providing controlled, consistent processing and an approval record needed for compliance. Budget codes can be assigned to workflows, but the workflow is the feature that performs the approval control.

**Learn more:** [Create budget register entries - Finance | Dynamics 365 | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-register-entries) · [Workflow system overview - Finance & Operations | Dynamics 365 | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/fin-ops-core/fin-ops/organization-administration/overview-workflow-system)

questions.question:
A client uses Dynamics 365 Finance for accounts receivable.  
  
You need to ensure that accounts receivable clerks enter the wire number for electronic payments.  
  
Which item should be configured as mandatory for the method of payment?
questions.explanation: For electronic payments, the wire number is recorded as the payment reference. Requiring a payment reference on the method of payment ensures that accounts receivable clerks must provide that value.

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
You have implemented Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
You need to implement interest fees to encourage customers to pay on time.  
  
Configure the required functionality. Each functionality may be used once, more than once, or not at all.

<DragDrop
  items={["Credit note","Invoice","Interest note"]}
  slots={[{"answer":"Credit note","id":"slot1","label":"A long-standing customer must have their interest fee waived."},{"answer":"Invoice","id":"slot2","label":"A customer’s interest fee was waived last month but did not pay their balance – an interest fee must be reinstated."}]}
  reuse={true}
  explanation={"Waiving an interest fee forgives the charge and creates a credit note or adjustment invoice. Reinstating a waived fee makes the amount due again and creates a debit invoice.\
\
**Learn more:** [Waive, reinstate, or reverse interest fees - Finance | Dynamics 365 | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/waive-reinstate-reverse-interest-fees)"}
/>","className":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You create a parent budget for the upcoming fiscal year for a parent company. The parent company is configured as its own legal entity.  
  
Franchises are configured as separate legal entities. Based on the prior year’s performance, the parent company sets the budget for each franchise.  
  
Ledger allocation rules, period allocation keys, and budget allocation terms have not been created. Budget line items must be allocated to each franchise’s budget.  
  
You need to ensure that the franchise budgets are allocated.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create ledger allocation rules. Set the allocation method to use ledger allocation rules.
Create period allocation keys. Set the allocation method to allocate across periods.
Set the allocation method to distribute.
Set the allocation method to aggregate.
Create budget allocation terms. Set the allocation method to allocate to dimensions.

questions.explanation:
The **Distribute** allocation method sends budget plan lines from a parent budget plan to the associated child budget plans, using the financial dimensions of the organizational units associated with those plans. It is the method intended to spread a centrally prepared parent budget to franchises; Aggregate performs the opposite, child-to-parent consolidation. [Budget planning data allocation | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-planning-data-allocation)

questions.question:
You must resolve the issue associated with the vendor invoice for bicycle tires.  
  
Which two selections should you choose to configure the charge?  
  
Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
For an Accounts payable charge that must be added to an item's cost rather than posted as an expense, configure the charge code with **Customer/Vendor** as the credit type to add the charge to the vendor account and **Item** as the debit type to add the charge to the item cost.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create charges codes - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/create-charges-codes)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
You need to meet the requirement for the Vendor aging report.  
  
What should you do?
questions.explanation:
In Dynamics 365 Finance, selecting **Payment positioning** on the Vendor aging report includes payments that have not been settled, enabling those payments to be reviewed on the report.\
\
**Learn more:** [Vendor aging report - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/hr-hr/dynamics365/finance/accounts-payable/vendor-aging-report)

questions.question:
You must rerun foreign currency revaluation and resolve the issue.  
  
How should the revaluation be run to achieve the expected outcome?  
  
Each method may be used once, more than once, or not at all.

<DragDrop
  items={["Standard","Minimum","Invoice date"]}

/>","className":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You need to configure customer posting profiles.  
  
Which three actions should you take?  
  
Each correct answer is part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Set up interest charges for domestic customers.
Configure international and domestic terms of payment.

questions.explanation:
Customer posting profiles support customer-group-specific Accounts receivable summary accounts, a liquidity account for cash flow forecasts, and interest calculation through an interest code and the Interest setting. Therefore, separate domestic and international receivables can be configured, cash flow forecasting can be enabled and supported by the profile, and interest charges can be set for domestic customers. Revenue accounts and payment terms are configured outside customer posting profiles. [Customer posting profiles — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/customer-posting-profiles)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Expense management in Dynamics 365 Finance and has two legal entities.  
  
CompanyA reimburses employees for travel-related expenses. CompanyB intends to reimburse remote employees monthly for travel-related expenses. All employees must complete expense reports.  
  
You need to configure an expense type that both companies can use.  
  
Which expense type category should you use?
questions.explanation:
Shared categories provide the basis for expense categories and can be shared across the legal entities in an organization. This lets both CompanyA and CompanyB use the same travel-related expense type for employee expense reports.

**Learn more:** [Set up expense categories](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/project-operations/expense/set-up-expense-categories) · [Expense management integration](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/project-operations/environment/resource-dual-write-expense)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company offers employee life insurance to every full-time employee. The employee life-insurance policies are paid to the insurance company twice yearly.  
  
Transactions for existing employees must be recognized in the general ledger twice each month with the employee's pay. Transactions for new employees must be recognized in the general ledger according to the employee's first pay date.  
  
You need to set up accrual schemes for the new fiscal year.  
  
Which two configurations should you use? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: For new employees, use a Credit accrual scheme. In the ledger accrual, set the offset to the first day of the fiscal year.
For current employees, use a Credit accrual scheme. In the ledger accrual, set the offset to the employee's first pay date.
For new employees, use a Debit accrual scheme. In the ledger accrual, set the offset to the employee's first pay date.
For current employees, use a Debit accrual scheme. In the ledger accrual, set the offset to the first day of the fiscal year.

questions.explanation:
Prepaid employee life-insurance costs are debit-side transactions that must be deferred and recognized as expense over the relevant coverage period. A Debit accrual scheme applies to the debit account on the journal voucher line. The accrual offset for current employees must begin on the first day of the fiscal year, while the offset for new employees must begin on each employee’s first pay date. Microsoft Learn documents that accrual schemes redistribute costs into the appropriate periods and that a Debit scheme replaces the debit main account on the journal voucher line.

**Learn more:** [Accruals overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/accruals-overview) · [Create accrual schemes - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/create-accrual-schemes)

questions.domain: Implement and manage accounts payable and expenses
questions.question:
A company is preparing to finalize its annual budgets.  
  
The company intends to use the Budget module in Dynamics 365 Finance for budget management.  
  
You need to create the new budgets. What should you do?

options.text: Create budget plans for multiple scenarios.
Create budget plans to define the revenues for a budget.
Combine previous year budgets into a single budget.

questions.explanation:
In Dynamics 365 Finance, budget plans define the expected revenues and expenditures for a budget cycle. Budget plan scenarios classify versions or categories of planning data, and consolidation combines plans across organizational levels rather than creating the revenue budget itself.\
\
**Learn more:** [Budget planning overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-planning-overview-configuration)

questions.domain: Implement and manage accounts payable and expenses
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are a Dynamics 365 Finance consultant who plans to configure the allocation base, cost behavior, and cost distribution.  
  
Which three actions are accomplished by these configurations? Each correct answer represents a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Spread costs from one cost object to one or more other cost objects by applying a relevant allocation base.
Measure and quantify activities, such as machine hours that are used, kilowatt hours that are consumed, or square footage that is occupied.
Spread the balance of the cost from one cost object to one or more other cost objects by applying a relevant allocation base.
Control which journals can be used in the costing process.
Classify costs according to their behavior in relation to changes in key business activities.

questions.explanation:
An allocation base measures activity quantities such as machine hours, consumed kilowatt hours, or occupied square footage. Cost distribution spreads cost from one cost object to one or more other cost objects using a relevant allocation base. Cost behavior classifies costs according to how they change in relation to key business activities. Distributing the balance of a cost object instead describes cost allocation.

**Learn more:** [Cost accounting terminology - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/cost-accounting/terms-cost-accounting) · [Allocation bases - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/cost-accounting/allocation-bases)

questions.question:
You need to ensure that employee receipts captured on mobile devices automatically match transactions to resolve the User1 issue.  
  
Which feature should you enable?
questions.explanation:
The Expense reports reimagined feature provides the redesigned expense experience that supports receipt matching. For OCR receipt capture, Microsoft requires Expense reports reimagined together with the Automatch and create expense from receipt feature; when receipts and expenses are included in an expense report, automatic matching is triggered.\
\
**Learn more:** [Capture a receipt using OCR](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/project-operations/expense/match-receipt-expense-ocr) · [Expense reports reimagined](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/project-operations/expense/expense-reports-reimagined)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
A customer invoice must be paid on or before the tenth day of the next month.  
  
You need to configure the payment setup.  
  
Which payment configuration should you use?
questions.explanation:
The **Current month** payment method uses the end of the invoice’s current month as the basis for the due-date calculation. With no additional months or days and a payment day of the 10th, the due date is the 10th day of the following month. Microsoft Learn describes payment days as specific dates of a month used in payment-term calculations and payment methods as the starting point for due-date calculation.

**Learn more:** [Establish customer payment terms - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/establish-customer-payment-terms) · [Define vendor payment terms - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-payable/tasks/define-vendor-payment-terms)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Users are incorrectly posting project and bank transactions in the General journal. The client wants to stop this from occurring in the future.  
  
You need to configure Dynamics 365 Finance so that account-type transactions are limited to **Ledger** only.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Use journal control to specify which account types are valid for the General ledger journal.
Use advanced ledger entries to define the account types that can be used in the General ledger journal.
Configure the voucher series associated with this journal to allow only ledger account types.
Create a journal template that has ledger as the account type and offset account type.

questions.explanation:
Journal control for a General ledger journal name restricts the account types that users can post. Configuring it to permit only the Ledger account type prevents project and bank account-type transactions from being entered in that journal.

**Learn more:** [General journal processing - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/general-journal-processing) · [Create advanced rules for journals - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/create-advanced-rules-journals)

questions.question:
You need to investigate User7's reporting issue.  
  
Why are certain transactions excluded?

options.text: User7 is running the report in CompanyB.
User7 is running the report in CompanyA.
The report is correctly excluding CustomerY transactions.
The report is correctly excluding CustomerZ transactions.

questions.explanation:
CustomerY is tax-exempt, so its transactions do not create payable sales tax and are correctly omitted from the sales tax payment report. In Dynamics 365 Finance, sales tax reporting is based on sales tax transactions and their applicable tax configuration.\
\
**Learn more:** [Sales tax overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/indirect-taxes-overview)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance to manage its fixed assets.  
  
The company uses laptops for three years before selling them externally.  
  
You need to process the sales of the laptops.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create a fixed asset disposal journal.
Use a free text invoice to record the sale.
Create a sales order for the sale of the asset.
Use an inventory movement journal to record the disposal.

questions.explanation:
A free text invoice is used to sell a fixed asset to an external customer. The invoice line can reference the fixed asset, and its fixed-asset transaction type is Disposal - sale, allowing the sale amount and asset disposal to be posted together.

**Learn more:** [Dispose of a fixed asset using a free text invoice - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/fixed-assets/tasks/dispose-fixed-asset-free-text-invoice) · [Fixed asset transaction options - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/fixed-assets/enter-fixed-asset-transactions)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You manage the ledger settlement process for a company that uses Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
The company needs an enhanced settlement process.  
  
You enable the Awareness between ledger settlement and year-end close feature so that only unsettled ledger transactions are included in the opening balance during the year-end process.  
  
The company must be able to settle transactions and process realized gains and losses from foreign-currency differences without manual intervention.  
  
You need to configure the system to fulfill these requirements.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Set up a new chart of accounts specifically for foreign currency transactions.
Disable the Awareness between ledger settlement and year-end close feature.
Ensure all transactions are posted within the same fiscal year before settling them.
Enable the Post foreign currency realized gains/losses for ledger settlements feature.

questions.explanation:
The Post foreign currency realized gains/losses for ledger settlements feature posts realized foreign-currency gains and losses during the ledger settlement process when debit and credit amounts differ in the accounting or reporting currency. It depends on the Awareness between ledger settlement and year-end close feature, which remains enabled to ensure that settled transactions are excluded from the next fiscal year's opening balance.

**Learn more:** [Ledger settlements - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/ledger-settlements) · [Awareness between ledger settlement and year-end close - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/awareness-between-ledger-settlement-year-end-close)

questions.domain: Implement and manage accounts payable and expenses
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Finance. It is based in the United States and sells a product online. The product is shipped to the United States, Canada, and Mexico. The product is sourced from Brazil.  
  
Legal entities must be configured for each country/region. A single ledger account must be used to track sales tax payable.  
  
You need to configure the system to track Use Tax.  
  
Which two parameters should you configure? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: single sales tax code for Brazil
single sales tax code for the United States
tax code for each legal entity

questions.explanation:
Sales tax codes are configured per legal entity, so a tax code is needed in each legal entity that must process use tax. Each tax code is linked to a ledger posting group, which specifies the main accounts for tax postings; the same ledger posting group can be assigned to all applicable tax codes to use one sales-tax-payable account.

**Learn more:** [Sales tax overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/indirect-taxes-overview) · [Set up Ledger posting groups for sales tax - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/set-up-ledger-posting-groups-sales-tax)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You work for a company that receives invoices in foreign currencies.  
  
You need to configure currency exchange rate providers and exchange rate types.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Configure exchange rate provider, create exchange rate type, and import the currency exchange rates.
Select the appropriate HTML key values from the available exchange rate providers. Then, use the provider for importing one currency exchange rate type.
Use a developer to write the HTML key values code to configure the currency exchange rate providers. Then, use the provider for importing a currency exchange rate type.
Use a developer to write the XML key values code to configure the currency exchange rate providers. Then, use the provider for importing a currency exchange rate type.

questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Finance uses the Configure exchange rate providers page to select a provider and enter its required configuration values. Currency exchange rates are then imported by choosing both an exchange rate provider and an exchange rate type. Built-in providers do not require custom HTML or XML key-value code.

**Learn more:** [Import currency exchange rates - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/import-currency-exchange-rates)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You need to resolve the issue reported by User4.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Change the status of the vendor collaboration request
Create a vendor account with the systemexternaluser role and the vendor admin (external) role
Remove the externalsystemuser role from the vendor
Manually create the vendor account with the systemuser role

questions.explanation:
A vendor collaboration administrator must use the external-user security context. A manually created account must have the **System external user** role instead of the automatically assigned System user role, and the **Vendor admin (external)** role grants the vendor-administration capabilities needed to manage vendor collaboration users.

You need to create the budget register entries. Which two fields must be configured when creating register entries? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
A budget register entry requires a budget model, which identifies the budget data set, and a budget code, which identifies the type and processing of the budget entry. Microsoft’s procedure for creating a budget register entry specifies selecting both fields on the Budget register entry FastTab.\

**Learn more:** [Create budget register entries - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-register-entries)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],An organization intends to establish intercompany accounting among legal entities in the organization.  
  
Automatic transactions between legal entities must satisfy these requirements:  
  
- Deliver systemwide integration and streamlining to save time.  
- Reduce errors and provide an audit trail with complete visibility into business activities and transaction histories within the legal entities.  
  
You need to configure intercompany accounting and establish pairs of legal entities that can transact with one another, explicitly defining the originating company and the destination company.  
  
Which three actions should you take? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Configure intercompany accounting in both the originating entity and destination entity.
Create intercompany main accounts to use for the due to and due from accounting entries.
Define intercompany accounting setup by creating legal entity pairs defining originating and destination companies.
Configure intercompany accounting in the destination entity only.

questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Finance intercompany accounting requires dedicated main accounts for Due to and Due from postings, a Daily journal name for intercompany journals, and an intercompany accounting setup that defines each legal-entity pair and identifies its originating and destination companies. This setup is shared systemwide rather than configured separately in each legal entity.

**Learn more:** [Intercompany accounting setup - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/intercompany-accounting-setup)

options.text: a manual journal approval with the journal assigned to the user group that the employees are assigned to
the controller’s security role so that he has approval privileges for General ledger journals
an alert that is sent to the controller when a journal name is created
a manual journal approval with the journal assigned to the controller’s user group

questions.explanation:
A manual journal approval assigned to the controller’s user group routes the journal for the required review before posting, creating the needed segregation of duties. General-journal workflow approval is designed to establish review and approval steps as an internal control.

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
You need to set up Accounts Receivable to accept pre-orders.  
  
Which feature should you use?
questions.explanation:
Customer prepayments for sales orders are handled through settlement: a prepayment can be settled against the sales order before the invoice is created, and it is subsequently applied to the invoice. The **Settle open transactions** feature supports this process.\

questions.question:
You need to change the taxing jurisdiction for Humongous Insurance’s subsidiary.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Configure sales tax groups for transactions that occur in China.
Configure dual currency support for sales tax.
Change the sales tax settlement period authority.
