A company uses Dynamics 365 Finance to manage fixed assets. It uses one legal entity for accounting and another legal entity for tax purposes. The company has 15 distinct fixed asset groups.  
  
The company creates a fixed asset group named Conveyor. You create a fixed asset that uses the Conveyor fixed asset group. The fixed asset is not linked to a legal entity.  
  
You need to ensure that both legal entities are associated with new fixed assets created for the Conveyor group.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
Books assigned to a fixed asset group are automatically assigned to each new fixed asset created in that group. Configuring the Conveyor group’s book setup associates the required accounting and tax books with every new Conveyor asset. Posting profiles define ledger accounts, while depreciation profiles define depreciation calculations.

**Learn more:** [Set up fixed assets - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/fixed-assets/set-up-fixed-assets) · [Set up fixed asset groups - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/fixed-assets/tasks/set-up-fixed-asset-groups)

questions.question:
A company intends to allocate revenue across occurrences by using a recognition basis.  
  
Which recognition basis can be used?
questions.explanation:
Monthly is a recognition basis that allocates revenue equally across the number of months specified in the occurrences. The recognition basis controls allocation across occurrences, whereas recognition conventions control schedule dates.\
\
**Learn more:** [Revenue recognition setup - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/revenue-recognition-setup)

questions.question:
Solution: In the **Accounts receivable parameters** form, select **None** as the credit type.  
  
In the **Customers** form, select the **Mandatory credit limit** check box.  
  
Does the solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
The Mandatory credit limit setting on a customer forces the system to check that customer’s credit limit even when the Credit limit type is set to None, which otherwise disables credit-limit checks for customers. Setting it for every customer makes the credit-limit check mandatory for all customer documents.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure the customer account payment method for B2B e-commerce sites](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/commerce/b2b/payment-method)

questions.question:
Solution: Set a credit limit for each customer and select the **Mandatory credit limit** check box on the Customers form.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A customer-specific credit limit establishes the allowed credit amount, and the Mandatory credit limit setting forces the system to check that limit for the customer, including when general credit-limit checking is otherwise not required.\
\
**Learn more:** [Credit limit holds FAQ - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/credit-hold-faq) · [Credit limit scenarios - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/credit-limit-scenarios)

questions.question:
Solution: Set a credit limit for each customer and select the **Mandatory credit limit** check box on the Customers form.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
The **Balance + packing slip** credit type does not apply credit-limit checks to all customer document types; it includes the balance and packing-slip activity rather than all documents. The **Mandatory credit limit** setting forces a credit check for the customer but does not broaden the document coverage defined by the credit-limit type. A configuration that covers all documents requires the **Balance + all** credit type.

**Learn more:** [Configure the customer account payment method for B2B e-commerce sites](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/commerce/b2b/payment-method) · [Confirm sales orders](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/tasks/confirm-sales-orders)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
Solution: In the **Accounts receivable parameters** form, select the **Balance + All** credit type.  
  
In the **Customers** form, select the **Mandatory credit limit** check box.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
The **Balance + All** credit-limit type evaluates the customer balance together with all document amounts. Setting **Mandatory credit limit** to Yes on a customer forces the system to check that customer's credit limit, including when its credit limit is 0.00; therefore, the configured credit check is mandatory for the customer documents.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure the customer account payment method for B2B e-commerce sites](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/commerce/b2b/payment-method) · [Credit limit holds FAQ - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/credit-hold-faq)

questions.question:
A company uses Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Project Operations.  
  
The company must be able to estimate a project's costs and create a fixed asset by using that project cost estimate.  
  
You need to ensure that the company can create a fixed asset from a project.  
  
Which project type should be used?
questions.explanation:
Investment projects support cost estimation for internal capital projects. When an investment project is eliminated, its accumulated work-in-progress value can be transferred to a fixed asset, enabling capitalization of the project costs.\
\
**Learn more:** [Project management and accounting overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/project-operations/prod-pma/overview-project-management-accounting)

questions.question:
A company has implemented basic budgeting functionality in Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
The company wants to allocate payroll-expense budget register entries to each department according to a predetermined percentage.  
  
You need to configure this allocation.  
  
Which functionality should you use?
questions.explanation:
Budget allocation terms define the percentage of a budget register entry to allocate to specific financial-dimension values, such as departments. Period allocation keys allocate amounts to periods, rather than to departmental financial dimensions.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create budget register entries - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-register-entries)

questions.question:
You must ensure that promotional gifts are posted to the appropriate account.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
Item groups associate inventory items with the ledger-account setup used for inventory postings. Assigning promotional gifts to the appropriate item group ensures that their inventory transactions post to the intended account.\
\
**Learn more:** [Post inventory main accounts by site for China - Finance | Dynamics 365 | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/fil-ph/dynamics365/finance/localizations/china/apac-chn-post-inventory-main-accounts-by-site) · [Implement cost management in Dynamics 365 Finance - Training | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/modules/implement-cost-management/)

options.text: The revenue recognition reallocation process cannot be run on project sales orders.
The revenue recognition reallocation process can be reversed after it is run.
You can run the revenue recognition reallocation process multiple times.
It multiple sales orders are involved, all sales orders must be for the same customer account.
The revenue recognition reallocation process can be run for sales orders with different transaction currencies.
The revenue recognition reallocation process can only be run one time. All changes must be finalized.

questions.explanation:
Revenue recognition reallocation is limited to sales-order revenue recognition rather than project sales orders. When more than one sales order is included, all orders must belong to the same customer account and must use the same transaction currency. lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You need to determine the posting issue for sales order 1234.

options.text: Validate that the revenue recognition schedule is populated on the sales order line.
Validate that the revenue recognition schedule is populated on the sales order header.

questions.explanation:
Revenue recognition schedules are generated for individual item sales and determine the journal entries needed to recognize revenue. Confirming that the schedule is populated on the applicable sales order line identifies whether the line has the required recognition schedule for posting.

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company has deployed Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
The company needs improved visibility into its cash flow and wants to reconcile bank accounts each day while receiving a timely view of check deposits.  
  
You need to configure the bank accounts to provide more accurate cash-flow timing.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
Bridging accounts record check deposits and other payments in a temporary account during the period before they clear the bank, then move the entry to the bank account upon clearance. This preserves visibility of pending funds and reflects bank-account cash timing more accurately. Microsoft documents bridging posting as a two-step process that can improve the timeliness of bank reconciliation.

**Learn more:** [Accounts payable postings — Bridging accounts](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/accts-payble-posting) · [Establish customer method of payment](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/tasks/establish-customer-method-payment)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You must correct the sales tax configuration to resolve User5's issue.  
  
Which three actions should you take? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Populate the sales tax code on the sales order line.
Assign the sales tax group to CustomerY.
Assign the relevant sales tax code to both the sales tax and item sales tax groups.
Populate the item sales tax group field on the sales order line.
Populate the sales tax group field on the sales order line.

questions.explanation:
Sales tax is calculated only when a transaction has both a sales tax group and an item sales tax group, and the applicable tax code is present in both groups. Sales tax groups are associated with the transaction party, such as CustomerY, while item sales tax groups are selected for the transaction item or line. The sales tax group can default from CustomerY; sales tax codes are maintained in the groups rather than entered directly on a sales order line.

**Learn more:** [Sales tax overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/indirect-taxes-overview) · [Set up sales tax groups and item sales tax groups - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/set-up-sales-tax-groups-item-sales-tax-groups)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Solution:  
  
- Configure two account structures: one for liability accounts that lists the (2000-2999) range with no subsequent dimensions, and one for Expense and Revenue accounts.  
- For Expense accounts (6000-6998) and Revenue accounts (4000-4999), configure asterisks in every dimension column.  
- For Expense account (6999), configure asterisks in every dimension. Configure an asterisk and quotes in the customer dimension.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
An account structure controls both valid dimension combinations and whether dimensions must be entered. Asterisks in every dimension column make all those dimensions required, so the configuration incorrectly requires Project and Customer for revenue accounts and Customer for expense accounts 6000–6998. Allowing a blank Customer value for account 6999 also violates its requirement that Customer be mandatory.

**Learn more:** [Financial dimensions and posting - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/default-dimensions) · [Create account structures - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/create-account-structures)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Solution:  
  
- Configure a single account structure.  
- Configure an advanced rule so that Liability accounts (2000-2999) do not display any dimensions when selected.  
- Configure an advanced rule that requires Customer for Expense account (6999).  
- Configure the structure with all dimension fields containing quotations.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Advanced rules can add financial-dimension segments only after the segments already defined in an account structure; they cannot remove or hide dimensions that the base account structure contains. Therefore, an account structure configured with all dimension fields cannot meet the requirement that liability accounts 2000-2999 have no dimensions posted.

**Learn more:** [Financial dimensions and posting - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/default-dimensions) · [Ledger account combinations - Finance & Operations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/fin-ops-core/dev-itpro/financial/ledgeraccountcombinations)

In Dynamics 365 Finance account structures, an asterisk permits any existing value for a segment, and allowing a blank segment makes that dimension optional. The configuration therefore requires the specified dimensions for the expense, revenue, and 6999 expense-account ranges, permits the designated optional dimensions, and uses a structure with no additional segments for liability accounts. The main-account ranges are non-overlapping, as required across account structures in the same ledger.

**Learn more:** [Account structures overview — Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/configure-account-structures) · [Ledger account combinations — Finance & Operations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/fin-ops-core/dev-itpro/financial/ledgeraccountcombinations)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],The controller at a company has several employees who enter standard General ledger journals. The controller wants to review these journal entries before they are posted. Currently, journal entries are posted without any review.  
  
You need to configure Dynamics 365 Finance to help establish a system-led review process that meets the controller’s needs.  
  
Which functionality should you configure?

options.text: an Advanced ledger entry workflow that uses the organizational hierarchy for journal posting, associated with the Advanced ledger journal name
signing limit policies with the controller assigned to the appropriate signing limit band
a manual journal approval with the journal assigned to the controller’s user group
a manual journal approval with the journal assigned to the user group that the employees are assigned to

questions.explanation:
Manual journal approval for standard General ledger journals assigns the approval responsibility to a specified user group and prevents posting until approval is completed. Assigning the journal to the controller’s user group ensures the controller, rather than the employees who prepared the journals, performs the required review. Microsoft documents journal workflows as a General ledger control for establishing review and approval steps before posting.

**Learn more:** [General journal processing - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/general-journal-processing)

A company uses Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Project Operations.  
  
The company must link fixed assets to subprojects in order to track the money it spends on asset maintenance.  
  
You need to configure subprojects to track the related fixed-asset transactions.  
  
Which two subproject types can you use? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
A project or subproject can be associated with a fixed asset by entering the fixed asset number on the project record. For this association, the project type must be either **Cost** or **Internal**. These types support tracking work, maintenance, or improvements related to the asset.

**Learn more:** [Fixed assets integration - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/fixed-assets/fixed-asset-integration)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are setting up account structures and advanced rules in Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
All balance sheet accounts require the **Business Unit** and **Department** dimensions. The **Shareholder distribution** account requires an additional **Principal** dimension.  
  
You need to configure the account structures.  
  
What are two possible ways to accomplish the goal? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Create a new main account for each of the company's principals. Then, create an account structure for all balance sheet accounts that includes the required dimension.
Create a new main account for Shareholder distribution. Add an advanced rule for the Principal dimension.
Create an account structure for all the balance sheet accounts. Set up an advanced rule for the Shareholder distribution account for the Principal dimension.
Create an account structure for balance sheet accounts without Shareholder distribution. Then, create a second account structure for Shareholder distribution that includes all required dimensions.

questions.explanation:
An account structure defines the financial-dimension segments that are required for applicable main accounts. An advanced rule can add a further segment when specified criteria, such as a particular main account, are met. Therefore, Business Unit and Department can be defined for all balance-sheet accounts while an advanced rule adds Principal for Shareholder distribution, or Shareholder distribution can be excluded from the general structure and assigned its own structure containing all three required dimensions.

**Learn more:** [Financial dimensions and posting - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/default-dimensions) · [Create and assign advanced rule structures](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/create-assign-advanced-rule-structures)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are a finance consultant. Your client requires you to configure cash flow forecasting.  
  
The client wants defined percentages of main accounts to contribute to separate cash flow forecasts for other main accounts.  
  
You need to configure Dynamics 365 for Finance to meet the client’s requirements.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: On the Cash flow forecasting setup form, configure the primary main account to assign a percentage to the dependent account.
Configure the parent/child relationship for the main account and subaccounts by using appropriate percentages.
Configure the cash flow forecasting setup for Accounts Payable before you configure vendor posting profiles.
On the Cash flow forecasting setup form, use the Dependent Accounts setup to specify which account and percentage is associated to the main account.

questions.explanation:
In Cash flow forecast setup, the **Dependent accounts** section creates forecast amounts in dependent main accounts. For each dependent account, the **Percent** value specifies the portion of the primary main account’s cash flow amount that contributes to that dependent account’s forecast.

**Learn more:** [Cash flow forecasting - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/cash-bank-management/cash-flow-forecasting)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Solution:  
  
- Configure realized-gain posting profiles for a specific main account and unrealized gains for all main accounts.  
- Configure realized and unrealized gains or losses for all vendors.  
- Configure unrealized and realized gains or losses posting profiles for all customers.  
- Configure realized and unrealized gains or losses posting profiles for every bank account.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
General ledger currency revaluation requires posting accounts for realized gains, realized losses, unrealized gains, and unrealized losses. A configuration that defines only realized and unrealized gains for General ledger leaves loss postings without the required configured accounts, so it cannot ensure that all applicable gains or losses post correctly.

**Learn more:** [Foreign currency revaluation for General ledger - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/foreign-currency-revaluation-general-ledger) · [Currency revaluation posting profiles - Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/currency-revalue-posting-profile)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Solution:  
  
- Set up posting profiles for unrealized gains and losses for all main accounts.  
- Configure realized gain accounts for every currency.  
- Configure unrealized gains and losses for each vendor account.  
- Set up a realized gains-and-losses posting profile for every customer group and bank account.  
  
Does the solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Currency revaluation posting profiles provide unrealized gain and loss posting for all modules, but realized gain and loss profiles are available only for Accounts payable and Accounts receivable. Bank currency revaluation posts unrealized gains or losses, so a realized gains-and-losses profile for bank accounts is not applicable. The configuration also does not establish realized-loss accounts.

**Learn more:** [Currency revaluation posting profiles — Dynamics 365 Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/es-es/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/currency-revalue-posting-profile) · [Bank foreign currency revaluation — Dynamics 365 Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/cash-bank-management/bank-revaluation)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Solution:  
  
- Set up currency revaluation posting profiles for General ledger for every applicable main account and each currency.  
- Choose unrealized gain and loss accounts for all currencies.  
- Set up realized gains and losses posting for all vendors.  
- Set up realized gains and losses posting for every customer group.  
  
Does the solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Currency revaluation posting profiles require module-specific configuration. Bank revaluation profiles support unrealized gain and loss entries at the bank, bank-group, or all-bank level, while realized gains and losses are available only for Accounts payable and Accounts receivable. Without Bank profile configuration, the setup does not ensure correct postings for Bank revaluations.

**Learn more:** [Currency revaluation posting profiles - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/pt-br/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/currency-revalue-posting-profile) · [Bank foreign currency revaluation - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/cash-bank-management/bank-revaluation)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company intends to implement basic budgeting functionality in Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
You need to configure the minimum number of components required to enable the functionality.  
  
Which three required components must you configure?  
  
Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
> NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Basic budgeting requires Budgeting parameters and a number sequence for budget register entries, the financial dimensions used for budgeting, and budget models and budget codes. Budget control rules are optional unless budget control is implemented, and general ledger posting profiles are not a required basic-budgeting component.

**Learn more:** [Budgeting overview - Finance | Dynamics 365 | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/basic-budgeting-overview-configuration)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Finance for its budget-control processes. The default over-budget option for every user group is **Prevent over-budget processing**.  
  
A purchasing agent needs to create a purchase order containing multiple lines. However, when the agent adds the final line, an error indicates that the financial-dimension value is over budget.  
  
You need to configure the system so that the purchasing agent can process purchase orders using this financial-dimension value.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create a new user group for the purchasing agent and define a rule where the group has a budget threshold less than 100.
Create a new user group for the purchasing agent and define user group permissions to prevent over-budget processing.
Define the collection of financial dimensions to pool the budgets for a secondary budget check.
Create a new user group for the purchasing agent and define user group permissions to allow over-budget processing.

questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Finance lets you configure over-budget permissions for user groups. A user group that allows over-budget processing provides its members permission to exceed available budget, overriding the default prevention behavior for the purchasing agent.

**Learn more:** [Budget control overview - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-control-overview-configuration)

questions.domain: Implement and manage accounts payable and expenses

options.text: Configure a company matching policy of a three-way match
Configure a company matching policy of non-required and specify the items that require a three-way match
Configure a company matching policy of two-way matching and set the matching policy for specific item and vendor combination level to three-way matching
Configure a company matching policy of two-way matching and specify the items that require a three-way match
Configure a company matching policy of two-way matching and specify the vendors that require a three-way match

questions.explanation:
Set the legal entity’s line matching policy to two-way matching so it applies by default, then override the matching policy to three-way matching for the relevant item-and-vendor combinations. Dynamics 365 Finance allows matching-policy overrides for a specific vendor, item, or item and vendor combination; the combination-level override restricts three-way matching to the designated items from that vendor.

**Learn more:** [Accounts payable invoice matching overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-payable/accounts-payable-invoice-matching) · [Three-way matching policies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-payable/three-way-matching-policies)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure journal approval.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Journal approval establishes review and approval controls for journal processing; it does not restrict selection of a journal name to a particular user group. Selection access must be controlled through the journal name’s user-group configuration.\
\
**Learn more:** [General journal processing - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/general-journal-processing)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure blocking and select **Private** for the user group value.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Setting a journal name as private for a specified user group restricts that journal name’s availability to members of that group. Assigning the accounts receivable user group therefore limits selection of the customer payment journal to that group.\
\
**Learn more:** [Customer payment overview - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/cash-bank-management/tasks/customer-payment-overview)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure journal control.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Journal control limits the companies, account types, and financial-dimension values that can be used with a journal name; it does not restrict the journal name by user group. User-group restrictions for a journal name are configured through Posting restrictions.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create advanced rules for journals - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/create-advanced-rules-journals)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure journal control.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?

options.text: Add a new or existing contact person to the vendor accounts that they are a contact for.
Deny or allow a contact person's access to documents on the vendor collaboration interface that are specific to the vendor account.
View and modify contact person information, such as the person's title, email address, and telephone number.

questions.explanation:
The Vendor (external) role permits an external vendor to work in the vendor collaboration interface, including viewing consignment inventory. Managing contact records or granting and denying other contacts’ access requires the Vendor admin (external) role.

questions.question:
You create a budget plan template in Microsoft Word as part of the budget-planning process.  
  
You try to upload the document to Dynamics 365 Finance, but the upload fails.  
  
You need to add an entity to the budget plan template.  
  
Which entity should you add?
questions.explanation:
A Word budget-planning justification template must include the `BudgetPlanJustification` entity. Other entities may also be used, but omitting this required entity causes uploading the document back to Dynamics 365 Finance to fail.\
\
**Learn more:** [Budget planning justification documents - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-planning-justification-docs)

questions.question:
You create a budget plan template in Microsoft Word as part of the budget-planning process.  
  
You try to upload the document to Dynamics 365 Finance, but the upload fails.  
  
You need to add an entity to the budget plan template.  
  
Which entity should you add?

options.text: Create one revenue schedule with milestones.
Create a new revenue schedule for each unit.
Create a reallocation posting for the warranty revenue.
Create the revenue schedule so that it uses the contract terms.

questions.explanation:
A milestone revenue schedule supports recognition at distinct contractual events using the specified percentage allocation: 25% at sale, 50% at shipment, and 25% at installation. The same schedule definition can be reused for units with that common recognition pattern. Revenue schedules determine when deferred revenue is released as contractual obligations are met; revenue reallocation is intended for contract changes that add sales-order lines.

**Learn more:** [Revenue recognition overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/revenue-recognition-overview) · [Revenue recognition on sales orders - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/revenue-recognition-so-basics)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company is planning to implement Dynamics 365 Finance and manages a large volume of customers.  
  
The finance team wants to enable the following capabilities for each customer set:  
  
- Create sales budgets.  
- Generate trade statistics, such as weekly sales.  
- Define ledger posting.  
- Define payment terms.  
  
You need to select the functionality that defines customer clusters.  
  
Which configuration should you select?
questions.explanation:
Customer groups define clusters of customer accounts for shared classification and processing. They can be used to organize sales budgets and trade statistics, to apply customer-group posting-profile settings, and to associate common payment terms. Customer posting profiles specifically control how customer transactions post to the general ledger; they do not themselves define the general customer clustering structure.

**Learn more:** [Customer posting profiles - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/customer-posting-profiles) · [Establish customer payment terms - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/establish-customer-payment-terms)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are a Dynamics 365 Finance expert for an organization.  
  
You need to configure the Financial period close workspace.  
  
Which three configuration processes should you use? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Create templates that contain the required tasks within the closing process and assign to closing role.
Create a separate closing schedule for every legal entity.
Assign a ledger calendar to the closing process.
Designate resources and their scope based on closing roles.

questions.explanation:
Financial close templates define the recurring tasks in a closing process, task areas organize those tasks by logical ownership, and a calendar assigned to the closing schedule determines the working days used to schedule task due dates. A single closing schedule can include multiple companies, while resources are configured as employees and given a workspace view.

**Learn more:** [Financial period close workspace - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/financial-period-close-workspace)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You manage fixed assets in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
You need to set capitalization thresholds.  
  
Which page should you use?
questions.explanation:
A capitalization threshold determines whether an acquired fixed asset is depreciated. In Dynamics 365 Finance, the threshold can be configured for a fixed asset group, allowing the depreciation treatment to be set by asset category. Main accounts and fixed asset posting profiles control ledger accounts, and released items control product information. Microsoft Learn documents a capitalization-threshold example for the computers fixed asset group.

**Learn more:** [Acquire assets through procurement - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/fixed-assets/acquire-assets-procurement) · [Set up fixed assets - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/fixed-assets/set-up-fixed-assets)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are configuring the Accounts payable module for a company.  
  
The company must establish a limit for the charges it will pay for particular items.  
  
You need to configure the charge limit. Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer is part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Enable invoice matching validation in the Accounts payable parameters
Enter the maximum amount when you set up the charges code
Use budget control with the specified charges code
Set the maximum charge amount in the Accounts payable parameters
Define the maximum charge amount on the vendor record

questions.explanation:
The maximum permitted charge is set in the **Maximum amount** field for the applicable charges code. Charge validation for vendor invoices requires **Enable invoice matching validation** to be selected on the Invoice validation tab of Accounts payable parameters. Microsoft documents that the charges-code maximum is used for vendor-invoice charge validation and that invoice matching validation enables that validation.

**Learn more:** [Create charges codes - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/create-charges-codes)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are the controller for a multi-entity organization that uses an identical chart of accounts and fiscal periods for every entity. You use the financial report designer in Dynamics 365 Finance to create, maintain, deploy, and view financial statements.  
  
You must generate consolidated financial statements by using a building block group to aggregate data across companies and financial dimensions.  
  
Which three actions should you take? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Create a column definition and use the period and year to map the appropriate periods for each company.
Create a row definition that includes all appropriate accounts in all companies in the rows.
Create a column definition that includes a financial dimension column for each company.
Create a reporting tree that includes a reporting node for each company.
Use the Reporting Unit field to select the tree and reporting unit for each column.

questions.explanation:
For legal entities that share the same chart of accounts and fiscal periods, Financial reporting consolidation uses a row definition containing the applicable accounts, a column definition for the required financial data columns, and a reporting tree with a node for each company. The reporting tree rolls each company’s data into the consolidated summary. Period and year mapping is used when legal entities have different fiscal calendars; reporting-unit selection for each column is used for an optional side-by-side company presentation.

**Learn more:** [Generate consolidated financial statements - Finance | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/generating-consolidated-financial-statements)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A customer is implementing Dynamics 365 Finance and wants to use the recurring invoice feature for accounts receivable.  
  
The recurring invoice template contains the start date and frequency. However, when the **Generate recurring invoices** job runs, no invoices are created even though the criteria are met.  
  
You need to ensure that invoices are generated.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Assign an invoice template to a customer on the invoice tab of the customer record.
Set the maximum billing amount on the recurring invoke template.
Associate a customer to the invoice template on the invoice template form.
Assign an invoice template to the customer posting profile.

questions.explanation:
Recurring free text invoices are generated only after the free text invoice template is assigned to the customer and the customer-specific recurrence details are configured on the customer’s Invoice tab. The start date and frequency are maintained with that customer-template assignment; a template by itself does not identify a customer to invoice. The maximum billing amount is optional, and a customer posting profile is not used to assign recurring invoice templates.

**Learn more:** [Set up and process recurring invoices - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/set-up-process-recurring-invoices) · [Assign a free text invoice template to a customer - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/tasks/assign-free-text-invoice-template-customer)

questions.question:
You administer a company’s account controls and bank balances and have a $100,000 credit limit from a bank.  
  
You must ensure that posting a transaction cannot cause the bank account to fall below the specified credit limit.  
  
You need to set up the bank account credit limit. What should you do?

options.text: Add גˆ’$100,000 in the bank credit limit.
Add $100,000 in the bank credit limit.
Define a credit limit of $100,000 on the invoicing vendor account
Set the Control Balance option to credit in the General ledger account associated with the bank account.

questions.explanation: A bank credit limit is the maximum authorized overdraft, so it represents the account’s lowest allowable balance. For a $100,000 facility, that lower bound is -$100,000; entering a negative bank credit-limit amount prevents postings that would take the balance below it.

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company has deployed Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
The company holds funds with three separate banks. Each bank has three individual accounts, for a company total of nine accounts. The system must default the bank information whenever a new account is created. All bank balances for one bank account must be updated at the same time.  
  
You need to configure the system.  
  
Which two entities should be used? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
A bank account record is required for each individual company account. A bank group stores shared bank information and is assigned to related bank accounts, so bank details can default when an account is created and accounts belonging to the same bank can be managed as a group.

**Learn more:** [Set up bank accounts (Russia) - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/de-de/dynamics365/finance/localizations/russia/rus-local-settings-requisites-bank-module)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are migrating data from a legacy system to Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
The legacy customer master data has no customer grouping. Customers must be assigned to a group.  
  
You need to configure the posting profile.  
  
What should you configure?

options.text: an interest code for a group of customers
a revenue account for sales orders transactions for a group of customers
terms of payment for a group of customers
a payable account for specific customers

questions.explanation:
A sales-order inventory posting profile supports a Revenue posting type whose main account can be scoped to an account group. Using the customer-group account relation posts sales-order revenue for customers in that group to the designated revenue account.

**Learn more:** [Sales order posting - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/sales-order-posting) · [Configure Accounts receivable and credit and collections - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/accounts-receivables-set-up-overview)

questions.question:
Solution: In the costing-version setup, enable **Allow cost records for active cost**.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A costing version must use the **Block activation** policy to prevent pending cost records from being activated. Allowing cost records for active cost does not block activation and therefore does not ensure a formal review before future standard costs affect inventory valuation. [Costing versions overview — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/costing-versions)\
\
**Learn more:** [Costing versions overview — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/costing-versions)

questions.question:
Solution: In the costing version setup, enable **Block activation of pending cost**.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
The **Block activation** policy prevents pending cost records in the costing version from being activated. This keeps new standard costs from becoming active—and therefore from being used for standard-cost inventory valuation—until the block is formally cleared after review.\
\
**Learn more:** [Costing versions overview - Supply Chain Management | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/costing-versions)

questions.question:
Solution: Create the costing version with its costing type set to planned costs rather than standard costs.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A costing version for planned costs is generally used for cost-calculation simulations, whereas standard-cost inventory valuation uses active cost records in a costing version for standard costs. The required approval control is the **Block activation** policy on the standard-cost costing version, which prevents pending costs from becoming active until the policy is removed after formal review.\
\
**Learn more:** [Costing versions overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/costing-versions) · [Update standard costs in a non-manufacturing environment](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/update-standard-costs-non-manufacturing-environment)

questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
The company must configure mandatory budget controls.  
  
You need to configure the required budget-control steps.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Import budgets directly into the general ledger.
Disable financial dimensions for budget validation.
Assign budget control to source documents.

questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Finance budget control is configured by selecting the source documents and journals that are subject to budget-control checks, including whether checks occur at the line or document level. This makes budget validation mandatory for the configured transaction documents.\
\
**Learn more:** [Budget control overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-control-overview-configuration)

questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
The company must configure mandatory budget controls.  
  
You need to configure the required budget-control steps.  
  
What should you do?
questions.explanation:
For a non-unit-based tax, the value configured for a sales tax code is the percentage applied to the tax origin to calculate the sales tax amount. Sales tax groups and item sales tax groups select applicable codes, and ledger posting groups specify the ledger accounts for posting; they do not define the tax rate.

**Learn more:** [Set up sales tax codes - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/set-up-sales-tax-codes)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company operates in the United States and Japan. Its accounting currency is USD. The company imports EUR-related exchange rates into its system.  
  
The company begins conducting transactions with suppliers in Japanese yen (JPY). To ensure accurate reporting, it configures USD-to-JPY exchange rates on the **Exchange rates** page.  
  
The company requires that all JPY transactions be converted to EUR first and then to USD for reporting.  
  
You need to configure the currency setup.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Define a specific exchange rate type for USD-to-JPY transactions.
Designate EUR as the system reference currency for triangulation.

questions.explanation:
Currency triangulation uses a designated reference currency as the intermediate conversion currency. Setting EUR as the system reference currency causes JPY amounts to be translated through EUR before conversion to the USD accounting currency, which enforces the required JPY-to-EUR-to-USD path.

**Learn more:** [Configure currencies in Dynamics 365 Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/modules/configure-currencies-dyn365-finance/)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A client needs Dynamics 365 Finance to calculate sales tax for a sales order line after an item is added. The sales tax group is already populated with a value.  
  
You must ensure that sales tax is calculated.  
  
Which field should be populated?
questions.explanation:
Sales tax calculation on a Finance document line requires both a sales tax group and an item sales tax group. The applicable sales tax codes are the codes common to those two groups, so when the sales tax group already has a value, the item sales tax group must be populated.

**Learn more:** [Sales tax overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/indirect-taxes-overview) · [Set up sales tax groups and item sales tax groups - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/set-up-sales-tax-groups-item-sales-tax-groups)

A client requires guidance for month-end closing procedures.  
  
The client must be able to prevent all teams, except Accounts payable and General ledger, from posting transactions for the month.  
  
You need to configure Dynamics 365 Finance so that only those two teams can transact during the period being closed.  
  
Which three actions should you take? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Create an access group called month end access for Accounts payable and General ledger team members.
Set all modules to none to prevent any transactions from being posted.
Configure the financial period close workspace tasks to the Accounts payable and General ledger teams only
Move the period status to on hold for your client's one legal entity.
Assign the security group month end access on the ledger calendar form for the modules they need access to.

questions.explanation:
Ledger calendar module access can be set to All, None, or a specific user group. Setting modules to None blocks posting, while assigning the month-end access group to the Accounts payable and General ledger modules permits only members of that group to post in those modules. Financial period close workspace assignments only organize closing work, and an On hold period cannot be posted to.

**Learn more:** [Mass financial period close - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/mass-financial-period-close) · [Close the general ledger at period end - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/close-general-ledger-at-period-end)

questions.question:
A client uses the budget planning process in Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
The client requires the capability to plan for a one-year, three-year, and five-year budget.  
  
You need to configure the various year-length options for use in the budgeting module.  
  
What should you do?
questions.explanation:
Budget cycles define the time period during which a budget is used and can cover part of a fiscal year or multiple fiscal years. Configure budget cycles with the required cycle time spans to support one-, three-, and five-year budgeting periods.\
\
**Learn more:** [Fiscal calendars, fiscal years, and periods - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/fiscal-calendars-fiscal-years-periods)

questions.question:
A client uses the budget planning process in Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
The client requires the capability to plan for a one-year, three-year, and five-year budget.  
  
You need to configure the various year-length options for use in the budgeting module.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Deactivate budget control and set it up again
Manually trigger a budget control check
Update the balances for budget raiser entries that were excided.
Use budget control data maintenance to reprocess the entries.

questions.explanation:
Budget control data maintenance can identify and reprocess documents that were not previously budget-checked because budget control was turned on or off. Reprocessing creates the required budget-control data for the previously posted entries.

**Learn more:** [Budget control maintenance tool - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-control-tool) · [Budget control overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-control-overview-configuration)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company plans to implement financial management by using Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
The company must be able to review cost changes for manufactured items without changing the currently active costs.  
  
You need to configure the costing versions.  
  
Which costing-version type should you configure?
questions.explanation:
A planned-cost costing version is used to simulate the effect of cost changes on calculated costs for manufactured items. It can hold pending incremental cost records separately, leaving the current active cost records unchanged. Microsoft Learn documents this planned-cost simulation approach.

**Learn more:** [Simulate cost changes by using a costing version for planned costs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/simulate-cost-changes-costing-version-planned-costs) · [Costing versions overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/costing-versions)

A company has numerous customers who do not pay their invoices on time.  
  
You need to use collection-letter functionality to manage customer delinquencies. What are two possible ways to accomplish this goal? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Cancel the collection letters after they are created and posted.
Print all of the collection letters.
Delete the collection letters after posting when an error occurs.

questions.explanation:
In Dynamics 365 Finance, created collection letters can be printed and then posted as part of the collection-letter processing workflow. Posting records the collection-letter action, while printing produces the customer communication. [Process collection letters — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/tasks/process-collection-letters)

questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
Accounts payable clerks notice that due dates and cash discount dates are incorrect on posted invoices.  
  
You need to correct the due dates and cash discount dates.  
  
What should you edit?

options.text: payment terms for the vendor transactions
setup of the terms of payment
discount dates and due dates for the vendor transactions

questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Finance lets users update the due date and cash discount dates directly for an individual vendor transaction. Editing those transaction dates corrects the posted invoice values without changing payment-term or calendar configuration.\
\
**Learn more:** [Vendor transactions list page - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-payable/vendor-transaction-list-page)

questions.question:
You are a Dynamics 365 Finance consultant.  
  
In the current system, you are unable to collaborate or track progress toward month-end close across legal entities.  
  
You need to resolve this issue.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
The Financial period close workspace organizes month-end closing tasks, assigns them to responsible people, and tracks task and schedule status across the companies included in a closing schedule.\
\
**Learn more:** [Financial period close workspace - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/financial-period-close-workspace)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You need to identify the cause of the issue reported by User1.  
  
What are two possible causes of the issue? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: The account structure is in draft status.
The financial dimensions were created in the incorrect legal entity.
User1's security is incorrectly set up.
The account structure has an asterisk for all dimensions.
The account structure has quotations for all dimensions.

questions.explanation:
Account-structure criteria determine whether each financial-dimension segment is mandatory, may be blank, and which values are valid. An asterisk in every dimension column requires a nonblank value for every dimension; quotation marks in every dimension column allow only blank values. Either configuration can prevent the intended ledger-account and financial-dimension combination from being entered or validated. Microsoft Learn’s account-structure example shows that `*;""` is required when both any value and a blank value must be allowed.

**Learn more:** [Account structures overview – Dynamics 365 Finance | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/sv-se/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/configure-account-structures) · [Creating, modifying, and deleting account structures – Dynamics 365 Finance | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/create-account-structures)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
Solution: Configure a posting definition for purchase orders.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Purchase order confirmation can create an encumbrance that reserves the committed amount. A posting definition controls the general-ledger postings for purchase-order encumbrances, enabling the reservation to be recorded when the purchase order is confirmed.\
\
**Learn more:** [Purchase order posting - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/purchase-order-posting) · [Posting definition examples - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/example-posting-definitions)

questions.domain: Implement and manage accounts payable and expenses
questions.question:
Solution: Configure item posting groups for purchase requisitions.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Funds are reserved for a confirmed purchase order through budget control and encumbrance configuration, not through item posting groups. Item posting groups control inventory posting behavior and do not create purchase-order budget reservations.\
\
**Learn more:** [Budget control overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-control-overview-configuration) · [Purchase order posting - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/purchase-order-posting)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure posting definitions for purchase requisitions.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Purchase-requisition posting definitions do not create an encumbrance or reserve funds when a purchase order is confirmed. Purchase-order budget control and the applicable purchase-order encumbrance configuration are required for that event.\
\
**Learn more:** [Purchase order year-end close - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/purchase-order-year-end-process)

questions.question:
You are implementing Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
Sales tax payable must post to the same collection of accounts across every legal entity.  
  
You need to configure the sales tax. What should you use?
questions.explanation:
A ledger posting group specifies the main accounts used to post sales-tax amounts, including the Sales tax payable account. Reusing the same posting group provides a consistent collection of sales-tax posting accounts across legal entities.\
\
**Learn more:** [Sales tax overview – Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/indirect-taxes-overview) · [Set up Ledger posting groups for sales tax – Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/set-up-ledger-posting-groups-sales-tax)

questions.domain: Implement and manage accounts payable and expenses
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company has deployed Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
The company remits taxes quarterly to the states of Florida, Nebraska, and Washington. These states are configured as tax authorities in Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
You need to configure the system so that tax payments can be remitted.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Associate the vendor record to the tax authority.
Set up a customer record for the tax authority.
Associate the vendor record to the settlement period.
Set up the jurisdiction and associate the jurisdiction to the tax authority.

questions.explanation:
A tax authority associated with a vendor account allows the sales tax settlement process to post the tax balance as an open vendor invoice. That invoice can then be included in the regular payment proposal to remit the tax authority payment.

**Learn more:** [Sales tax overview - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/indirect-taxes-overview) · [Set up sales tax settlement periods - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/set-up-sales-tax-settlement-periods)

questions.domain: Implement and manage accounts payable and expenses
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],The controller at a company has several employees who enter standard General ledger journals. The controller wants to review these journal entries before they are posted. At present, journal entries are posted without review.  
  
You need to configure Dynamics 365 Finance to help establish a system-led review process that meets the controller’s needs.  
  
Which functionality should you configure?

options.text: an Advanced ledger entry workflow that uses the organizational hierarchy for journal posting, associated with the Advanced ledger journal name
an alert that is sent to the controller when a journal name is created
a manual journal approval with the journal assigned to the controller’s user group
the controller’s security role so that he has approval privileges for General ledger journals

questions.explanation:
Manual journal approval designates an approving user group and holds a journal from posting until a member of that group approves it. Assigning the controller’s user group therefore enforces the required review of standard General ledger journals before posting.

**Learn more:** [General journal processing - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/general-journal-processing)

You must modify the sales tax configuration to fix the issue for User3.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create multiple settlement periods and assign them to the US tax vendor.
Create multiple sales tax remittance vendors and assign them to the settlement period.
Run the payment proposal to generate the sales tax liability payments.

questions.explanation:

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
When you attempt to acquire a fixed asset, the system displays this error:  
  
> Account for the transaction type, value model, does not exist for fixed asset ASSET-001.  
  
You need to fix the error.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Link a main account to the asset group book.
Create a main account for the acquisition transaction type.
Enter a main account in the fixed asset posting profiles for the acquisition.
Complete the offset account in the journal for the acquisition.

questions.explanation:
Fixed asset acquisition posting requires a main account configured in Fixed asset posting profiles for the applicable book/value model and the Acquisition transaction type. That posting-profile mapping supplies the fixed asset ledger account used for the acquisition; without it, Finance reports that no account exists for the transaction type and value model.

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company is implementing Dynamics 365 Finance and uses a third party for support services.  
  
You need to configure a payment method that enables the company to reimburse any expenses reported by the third-party service provider.  
  
Which two methods should you use? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation: In Dynamics 365 Finance, expense reports can only be created for people who exist as Worker records, and non-employee workers (such as contractors or third-party service providers) can be flagged accordingly; however, actual disbursement of funds through Accounts Payable requires the claimant to also be set up as a Vendor with a defined method of payment, since AP payment processing (checks, EFT, etc.) is driven off vendor payment configuration rather than employee payroll. Configuring both a Worker record (to allow expense entry/approval) and a Vendor record (to allow AP to issue the reimbursement) together enable end-to-end reimbursement of a non-employee's expenses.

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Proposed solution:  
  
- Configure **General ledger parameters**:  
  - Set **Delete close of year transactions** to **Yes**.  
  - Set **Create closing transactions during transfer** to **Yes**.  
  - Set **Fiscal year status to permanently closed** to **No**.  
- Define the **Year-end close template**:  
  - Assign a retained earnings main account to each legal entity.  
  - Set **Financial dimensions will be used on the Opening transactions** to **No**.  
  - Set **Transfer profit and loss dimensions** to **Close All**.  
- Set every prior and future Ledger period to **On Hold**.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
An On hold ledger period cannot be posted to, although it can later be reopened. Because the previous year’s Period 13 is set to On hold, first-quarter accounting adjustments cannot be posted into that period unless it is reopened; therefore, the configuration does not meet the adjustment-posting requirement. The other settings support rerunning the close while deleting earlier close entries and carrying profit-and-loss dimensions into retained earnings.

**Learn more:** [Year-end close - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/year-end-close) · [Mass financial period close - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/mass-financial-period-close)

Solution:  
  
- Configure General ledger parameters.

  - Set **Create closing transactions during transfer** to **No**.  
  - Set **Fiscal year status to permanently closed** to **No**.

questions.explanation:

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Solution:  
  
- Configure General ledger parameters.  
  - Set the **Delete close of year transactions** option to **Yes**.  
  - Set the **Create closing transactions during transfer** option to **Yes**.  
  - Set the **Fiscal year status to permanently closed** option to **Yes**.  
- Define the Year-end close template.  
  - Assign a retained earnings main account to each legal entity.  
  - Set the **Financial dimensions will be used on the Opening transactions** option to **Yes**.  
  - Set **Transfer profit and loss dimensions** to **Close All**.  
- Set every prior and future Ledger period to a status of **On Hold**.  
  
Does this solution fulfill the goal?
questions.explanation:
A permanently closed fiscal year cannot be reopened, so adjustments cannot be posted to its Period 13. This conflicts with the requirement to post first-quarter accounting adjustments into the prior year. Setting deletion of existing year-end entries to Yes does ensure that a rerun removes the previous opening and optional closing transactions, while Close all preserves profit-and-loss financial-dimension values in retained earnings.

**Learn more:** [Year-end close - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/year-end-close)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A client has specialized accounting requirements that sometimes call for posting definitions.  
  
You need to implement posting definitions.  
  
In which scenario should posting definitions be implemented?

options.text: when financial dimensions need to default from the vendor record onto an invoice
when only certain dimensions are allowed to post with certain main account combinations
when creating multiple balanced ledger entries based on transaction types or accounts
when the system needs to automatically post a transaction to the accounts receivable account on invoice posting

questions.explanation:
Posting definitions match transaction accounts and dimensions against configured criteria and generate the required ledger entries, including balancing entries. They are used to create additional balanced accounting entries according to transaction types or account-based rules.

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],An organization is moving to Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
One of the organization's legal entities must use different main accounts for six months.  
  
You need to configure the legal-entity override dates. Which two actions can you take? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Set the value of the override date field at the legal entity level to be more restrictive.
Set the value of the override date field at the shared level to be more restrictive.
Set the value of the override date field at the legal level to be less restrictive.
Set the value of the override date field at the shared level to be less restrictive.

questions.explanation:
Legal entity overrides allow a main account to be active or suspended for a specified period in a particular legal entity. Shared-level overrides cannot be more restrictive than legal-entity-level overrides; consequently, the legal-entity setting may be more restrictive, while the shared-level setting may be less restrictive.

**Learn more:** [Plan your chart of accounts - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/plan-chart-of-accounts) · [Financial dimensions and tags - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/financial-dimensions)

questions.question: lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Which configuration enables User4 to make a purchase?

options.text: Budget model configuration is configured to allow certain purchases to exceed budget.
Budget is posted at the dimension level. Budget control is managed at main account level.
Budget funds available are configured to allow dimension budget overrides.
Budget is posted at the main account level. Budget control is managed at the department level.

questions.explanation:
Budget control can be configured to evaluate selected financial dimensions rather than every budget dimension. Managing budget control at the main-account level means a department-level budget overrun does not by itself block a purchase; the purchase can proceed when the applicable main account has available budget. Microsoft documents that budget-control rules are based on the financial dimensions enabled for budget control and can be scoped to selected main accounts.

**Learn more:** [Budget control overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-control-overview-configuration)

questions.explanation:

questions.question:
You must configure the system to satisfy the fiscal year requirements.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Add an additional period to ledger calendars.

questions.explanation:
A new fiscal calendar establishes the required fiscal-year framework, including its fiscal years and accounting periods. Fiscal calendars are independent and can be created separately when an organization or legal entity requires a different fiscal-year structure. A closing period is intended only to separate general-ledger transactions generated during year-end close.\
\

questions.question:
A company deploys Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance to manage fixed assets. The company adds a laptop as a fixed asset.  
  
You run a depreciation proposal and notice that laptops are not eligible for depreciation.  
  
You need to identify why the laptops cannot be depreciated.  
  
Which feature should you review?
questions.explanation:
The capitalization threshold controls which acquired fixed assets qualify for automatic depreciation. If an asset does not meet the configured threshold, its **Calculate depreciation** setting is set to **No**, so it is excluded from depreciation proposals.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set up fixed assets - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/fixed-assets/set-up-fixed-assets)

questions.question:
A company has implemented basic budgeting functionality in Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
The company needs to allocate budget register entries for sales expense amounts to each period according to a predetermined percentage.  
  
You need to configure this allocation.  
  
Which functionality should you use?
questions.explanation:
A period allocation key defines the percentage of a budget register entry that is allocated to each specific period. Budget allocation terms are used instead for allocations to financial-dimension values.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create budget register entries - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-register-entries)

The company intends to consolidate invoicing.  
  
You need to configure the system for invoice consolidation.  
  
Which two features should you enable? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Subscription billing is the prerequisite feature for its modules. Recurring contract billing provides recurring billing controls, including consolidated invoicing; therefore both must be enabled. Revenue and expense deferrals and multiple element revenue allocation serve revenue-recognition functions, not invoice consolidation.

Which task can this vendor carry out?
