questions.explanation:
The Vendor (external) role supports operational vendor-collaboration activities, including viewing consignment inventory. Contact-person creation and maintenance permissions are administrative functions associated with the Vendor admin (external) role. Microsoft Learn documents that external vendors can use the vendor collaboration interface to view consignment inventory.

**Learn more:** [Vendor collaboration with external vendors](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/vendor-collaboration-work-external-vendors) · [Manage vendor collaboration users](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/manage-vendor-collaboration-users)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance. It purchases, creates, and acquires fixed assets through purchase orders.  
  
The system must acquire the fixed asset when a vendor invoice is posted. You need to process the transaction.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Select a procurement category in a purchase order line and leave the fixed asset group blank.
Manually create a fixed asset before the fixed asset number is added to the purchase order.
Leave the fixed asset number blank on the purchase order.
Run a fixed asset acquisition proposal before a fixed asset number can be added to a purchase order.

questions.explanation:
For an existing fixed asset referenced on a purchase order, create the fixed asset before entering its fixed asset number on the purchase order line. With asset acquisition from purchasing enabled, posting the vendor invoice automatically posts the acquisition transaction.

**Learn more:** [Acquire assets through procurement - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/fixed-assets/acquire-assets-procurement) · [Set up fixed assets - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/fixed-assets/set-up-fixed-assets)

questions.domain: Implement and manage accounts payable and expenses
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],An organization purchases a building.  
  
You must register and record the building as a fixed asset in Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
What are three possible ways to accomplish this goal? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Select an account type of Fixed Asset and a transaction type of Acquisition with a General Journal
Eliminate the project to a fixed asset
Create a sales invoice to record and register the fixed asset
Select an acquisition transaction type within a fixed asset journal
Use the sales order process to acquire the asset

questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Finance permits acquisition transactions in the General journal and in Fixed assets journals. It also supports automatically posting an asset acquisition when an estimate project is completed and eliminated to a fixed asset. Accounts receivable free-text invoices record fixed-asset disposal-sale transactions, while asset purchases use procurement rather than the sales-order process.

**Learn more:** [Fixed asset transaction options - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/fixed-assets/enter-fixed-asset-transactions) · [Fixed assets integration - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/fixed-assets/fixed-asset-integration)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
The company requires that every incoming invoice be entered into the system when it arrives. The accounts payable manager must then approve the invoices.  
  
You need to enter the invoice details into the system’s invoice pool for the approval process.  
  
What should you use to enter the invoice information?
questions.explanation:
The invoice register is used to quickly enter incoming vendor invoices and accrue the expense. Together with the vendor invoice pool, it supports the subsequent invoice matching and approval process; the invoice approval journal is used to approve invoices after they have been registered.

**Learn more:** [Key invoice data into Accounts payable using invoice pool](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-payable/tasks/key-invoice-data-into-ap-system-invoice-pool) · [Vendor invoices overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-payable/vendor-invoices-overview)

questions.question:
A company has implemented basic budgeting functionality in Dynamics 365 Finance across multiple departments that belong to the same legal entity.  
  
Managers must be able to identify and track budgets by department.  
  
You need to configure the system.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
A budget model with submodels provides a common budgeting structure for one legal entity while maintaining separate, identifiable budget data for individual departments. Budget models are a core component of basic budgeting and are used when creating and analyzing budget register entries; submodels support departmental separation within the overall model.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set up and use basic budgeting in Dynamics 365 Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/modules/setup-use-basic-budgeting-finance/)

questions.domain: Implement and manage accounts payable and expenses
questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
The company needs to send a refund check by using a customer payment journal. The refund check must be generated before a user can post the refund payment journal.  
  
Which option should be configured?
questions.explanation:
Configure the payment status as **Sent**. Payment generation changes the payment journal line to Sent; requiring that status for posting prevents posting while the refund check has not been generated.\
\
**Learn more:** [Refund payment processing in the customer payment journal](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/refund-customers) · [Set up and process payment orders for Russia](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/localizations/russia/rus-payment-order-settings-processing)

questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
The company needs to send a refund check by using a customer payment journal. The refund check must be generated before a user can post the refund payment journal.  
  
Which option should be configured?

options.text: Jacksonville -Duval CT -FL -FL Special 1 -FL Special 2 -FL Special 3 -FL Special 4 -Lake Worth -Palm Beach CT
Jacksonville -Duval CT -FL -FL Special 1 -FL Special 2 -FL Special 3 -FL Special 5

questions.explanation:
In Dynamics 365 Finance, the applicable tax codes are those included in both the sales tax group and the item sales tax group. The shared codes are Jacksonville, Duval CT, FL, FL Special 1, FL Special 2, and FL Special 3. [Sales tax overview — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/indirect-taxes-overview)

**Learn more:** [Sales tax overview — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/indirect-taxes-overview)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are setting up automatic bank reconciliation functionality for a company with multiple bank accounts. The company wants to import its bank statements.  
  
You need to import electronic bank statements in order to reconcile the bank accounts.  
  
Which three actions can you perform? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Select all the bank accounts for the bank statement files, and then upload all files
Select Account reconciliation on the bank account form
Import bank statements from the Data management workspace
Navigate to Import statement on the Bank Statements page of Cash and Bank Management
Select Import statement for multiple bank accounts in all legal entities, and then upload a zip file

questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Finance supports importing electronic statements from the bank reconciliation workflow reached through a bank account and directly from the **Bank statements** page by using **Import statement**. For multiple statement files and accounts across legal entities, enable **Import statement for multiple bank accounts in all legal entities** and upload one ZIP file containing the statement files. The import process identifies the appropriate bank accounts from the statement data and processes each file in the archive.

**Learn more:** [Reconcile bank statements by using advanced bank reconciliation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/cash-bank-management/reconcile-bank-statements-advanced-bank-reconciliation) · [Set up advanced bank reconciliation import by using Electronic reporting](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-payable/import-BAI2-ER)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
A company enters into a four-year contract for an IT support project. The manager needs to know how the revenue amounts will be allocated over the four-year term.  
  
You need to configure a revenue schedule to calculate the revenue amount for each month.  
  
Which setup should you use?
questions.explanation:
A four-year contract spans 48 months, so a 48-month revenue schedule provides one monthly allocation period for each month of the contract term.\
\
**Learn more:** [Revenue recognition overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/revenue-recognition-overview)

questions.question:
A company enters into a four-year contract for an IT support project. The manager needs to know how the revenue amounts will be allocated over the four-year term.  
  
You need to configure a revenue schedule to calculate the revenue amount for each month.  
  
Which setup should you use?

options.text: Select the fixed asset checkbox on the invoice.
Create the fixed assets in the fixed asset module and then acquire the asset.
Create the fixed assets in the fixed asset module and then select the fixed asset checkbox on the product receipt.
Reverse the product receipt and then repost it.

questions.explanation:
Fixed assets acquired through purchase orders are acquired when the vendor invoice is posted. Selecting the fixed-asset option on the invoice line enables the asset to be created and acquired as part of invoice posting, subject to the Fixed assets purchasing integration settings.

**Learn more:** [Acquire assets through procurement - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/fixed-assets/acquire-assets-procurement) · [Create and acquire assets from Accounts payable - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/fixed-assets/tasks/create-acquire-assets-accounts-payable)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You must view the results of Fourth Coffee Holding Company's consolidation.  
  
Which three locations display the financial consolidation results? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: a financial report run against the company Fourth Coffee
a trial balance in the Fourth Coffee Holding Company
a trial balance in the company Fourth Coffee
a financial report run against the Fourth Coffee Holding Company
the consolidations form in Fourth Coffee Holding Company

questions.explanation:
Consolidation combines subsidiary results into a consolidation company. The results can be viewed by running a financial report against that consolidation company, reviewing its Trial balance list page, or viewing the consolidation transactions and balances on its Consolidations page.

**Learn more:** [Financial consolidations and currency translation overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/financial-consolidations-currency-translation)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
You are implementing Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
Subledger entries must be automatically transferred to the general ledger.  
  
You need to configure a batch-transfer rule.  
  
Which two options should you choose? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Finance supports **Asynchronous** transfer, which schedules subledger accounting-entry transfer to the general ledger immediately, and **Scheduled batch** transfer, which adds entries to a queue for processing at a scheduled time. These are the two available transfer options for subledger batches.\
\
**Learn more:** [Subledger transfer to the general ledger - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/subledger-transfer)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are configuring Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
You must implement advanced bank reconciliation.  
  
Which three actions should you take? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Perform automatic matching and creation of reconciliation journals.
Import bank statements through the Data entity framework.
Configure matching rules and matching groups for bank transactions.

questions.explanation:
Advanced bank reconciliation requires a bank statement import configuration, number sequences for reconciliation identifiers and references, and reconciliation matching rules (organized into matching rule sets/groups) to define automatic matching criteria. Automatic matching and reconciliation-journal creation occur when reconciling statements after configuration is complete.

**Learn more:** [Advanced bank reconciliation overview - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/cash-bank-management/advanced-bank-reconciliation-overview) · [Advanced bank reconciliation setup process - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/cash-bank-management/configure-advanced-bank-reconciliation)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
An accounts payable clerk runs a payment proposal and creates payment lines from that proposal.  
  
The clerk notices that the system creates separate lines for each invoice rather than one payment line for all invoices.  
  
You need to configure the system to create one payment line for all invoices that belong to one vendor.  
  
What should you configure?

options.text: payment type for the method of payment to Other
payment status on the method of payment to Approved
period for the method of payment to Total

questions.explanation:
For a vendor method of payment, setting the **Period** field to **Total** groups the vendor’s invoices into a single payment line rather than creating separate payment lines per invoice.

**Learn more:** [Set up method of payment for ISO20022 credit transfer - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/localizations/europe/set-up-method-payment-iso20022-credit-transfer)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are configuring Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
All sales transactions are currently being approved, resulting in many fraudulent transactions.  
  
To authorize transactions, the payment provider requires verification of the following information:  
  
- account holder name  
- billing address  
- postal code  
  
You need to configure the system so that only transactions with a verified address are approved.  
  
Which option should you select for credit card authorization?
questions.explanation:
The Billing postal code address-verification level compares the cardholder name, billing address, and postal code with the credit card company’s information. It is therefore the setting that enforces verification of all information required by the payment provider.

**Learn more:** [Credit card setup, authorization, and capture - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/credit-card-authorizations)

questions.question:
You are setting up the Fixed assets module in a Dynamics 365 Finance environment.  
  
You need to create a fixed asset.  
  
Which two settings are required? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
A fixed asset must be assigned to a fixed asset group, which determines defaults and associated books. A name is entered for the asset record. Asset numbering can be generated from the number sequence assigned to the group, so a number sequence is not a required asset setting.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set up fixed assets - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/fixed-assets/set-up-fixed-assets) · [Create a fixed asset - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/fixed-assets/tasks/create-fixed-asset)

questions.question:
You are setting up the Fixed assets module in a Dynamics 365 Finance environment.  
  
You need to create a fixed asset.  
  
Which two settings are required? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Configure the account structure to specify which financial dimensions are valid for which main accounts.
Train users to select the Validate button in the current journal configuration so that the correct account and dimension combination is used.
Configure financial dimension sets to limit which financial dimensions are valid for which main accounts.
Associate the correct main accounts to that financial dimension on the financial dimension setup form.

questions.explanation:
Account structures define which financial-dimension values are valid in combination with particular main accounts and enforce the allowed ledger-account combinations during entry and posting.

**Learn more:** [Financial dimensions and posting - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/default-dimensions) · [Enter account and dimension combinations (segmented entry control) - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/enter-account-dimension-combinations-segmented-entry-control)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are configuring the Accounts payable module and vendor invoice policies for an organization.  
  
You need to configure vendor invoice policies that run when vendor invoices are posted in the system.  
  
In which two ways can the policies be set up? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Set up invoice matching validation for vendor invoice policy.
Configure the vendor invoice workflow to run the policies.
Run the policies when you post a vendor invoice by using the Vendor invoice page and when you open the Vendor invoice policy violations page.
Apply the policies to invoices that were created in the invoice register or invoice journal.

questions.explanation:
Vendor invoice policies can be configured to run when an invoice is submitted to the vendor invoice workflow, and they run when an invoice is posted through the Vendor invoice page or when the Vendor invoice policy violations page is opened. Invoice matching validation is a separate Accounts payable parameter, and vendor invoice policies do not apply to invoices created through the invoice register or invoice journal.

**Learn more:** [Set up vendor invoice policies - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/ro-ro/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/tasks/set-up-vendor-invoice-policies)

questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
The company has decided to implement basic budgeting to track budgeted versus actual amounts.  
  
You need to configure the system to track and identify budget transactions and establish controls for budget balance updates.  
  
What should you define?
questions.explanation:
A budget cycle time span defines the starting and ending periods for budgeting and budget control. It provides the time framework in which budget amounts and actuals are evaluated and budget-control checks are applied.\
\
**Learn more:** [Budget control overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-control-overview-configuration)

questions.domain: Implement and manage accounts payable and expenses
questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
The company has decided to implement basic budgeting to track budgeted versus actual amounts.  
  
You need to configure the system to track and identify budget transactions and establish controls for budget balance updates.  
  
What should you define?

options.text: financial dimensions for department and division

questions.explanation:
Financial dimension sets are ordered lists of financial dimensions used to summarize General ledger data, with a primary use of defining a trial balance. Creating sets for Main account + Department + Division and for Main account + Department makes both grouping options available as trial balance parameters.

**Learn more:** [Financial dimension sets - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/financial-dimension-sets)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You need to identify why CustomerX is unable to confirm an additional sales order.  
  
What are two possible reasons? Each answer is a complete solution.  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: The credit limit parameter is set to Balance + All.
The credit limit is set to 0.
An inventory item is out of stock.
The inventory safety stock is set to 0.

questions.explanation:
A **Balance + All** credit check includes the customer’s outstanding balance and open sales orders when calculating available credit, so confirmation can be stopped when that combined exposure exceeds the credit limit. With Credit management enabled, a customer credit limit of **0** represents no credit and can place sales orders on credit hold. Inventory being out of stock and a safety-stock value of zero do not by themselves block sales-order confirmation.

**Learn more:** [Confirm sales orders - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/tasks/confirm-sales-orders) · [Credit limit holds FAQ - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/credit-hold-faq)

questions.question:
A company intends to distribute revenue across occurrences by using a recognition basis.  
  
Which recognition basis can be used?
questions.explanation:
An actual start date is a valid recognition basis for spreading revenue across occurrences. Microsoft’s revenue-recognition migration guidance gives an example of revenue spread across 12 equal occurrences using an actual start date. [Microsoft Learn: Migrate to subscription billing from revenue recognition](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/guidance/techtalks/finance-subscription-billing-migrate)\
\
**Learn more:** [Microsoft Learn: Migrate to subscription billing from revenue recognition](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/guidance/techtalks/finance-subscription-billing-migrate)

questions.question:
Solution: Create budget plans across multiple scenarios.  
  
Does the solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Finance Budget planning supports creating, analyzing, and updating budget plans for multiple scenarios. Budget plan scenarios represent versions of planning data, enabling alternative budget data to be prepared and compared.\
\
**Learn more:** [Budget planning overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-planning-overview-configuration)

questions.question:
Solution: Create budget plans to define the revenue for a budget.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
In Dynamics 365 Finance, budget plans are used to define expected revenue and expenditures for a budget cycle, so they can be used to define budget revenue.\
\
**Learn more:** [Budget planning overview - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-planning-overview-configuration)

questions.domain: Implement and manage accounts payable and expenses
questions.question:
Solution: Combine budgets from several legal entities into a master budget.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A Dynamics 365 Finance budget planning process is linked to a legal entity, and parent budget-plan consolidation is for organizational levels within that process. Budget planning data from multiple legal entities must be consolidated through Financial reporting; it cannot be combined into a single master budget in the Budget module.\
\
**Learn more:** [Budget planning overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-planning-overview-configuration) · [Consolidation and elimination overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/consolidation-elimination-overview)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
You plan to manage delinquent customers by monitoring the collections process in Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
You need to use the Collections list page to monitor that collections process.  
  
What must you do first?
questions.explanation:
An aging snapshot must exist before the Collections list page can be used, because the page shows information only for customers whose aging snapshot has been created. Running **Age customer balances** creates the required snapshot; customer pools are optional filters for collections information.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set up collections - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/set-up-collections) · [Review collections information - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/tasks/review-collections-information)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
You need to resolve the employee issue concerning expense-report policy violations.  
  
Which parameter should you use?
questions.explanation:
The **Evaluate expense management policies** parameter determines when expense policies are checked. It can evaluate a violation when an expense entry is entered and saved, rather than waiting until the expense report is submitted for approval, so employees receive policy-violation feedback while entering the transaction line.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure Expense management parameters](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/project-operations/expense/configure-expense-management-parameters)

questions.question:
You need to resolve the issue of sales orders posting to a closed period.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Permanently close the period for all modules.
Use a ledger calendar to update period status.
Use a ledger calendar to update module access.

questions.explanation:
Ledger calendars control posting permissions by application module. Updating module access for the Sales and marketing module prevents sales orders from posting in that period without unnecessarily closing access for every module or permanently closing the period.\
\
**Learn more:** [Mass financial period close - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/mass-financial-period-close)

options.text: Configure the behavior for forecasts of transactions that affect the liquidity accounts of the company.
Identify and list all the liquidity accounts.
Run the cash flow calculation process.

questions.explanation:
Cash flow forecasting requires the company’s liquidity accounts to be identified and tracked, forecasting behavior to be configured for transactions that affect those accounts, and the cash flow calculation process to be run to project future cash impacts. Microsoft documents these as the required setup and calculation activities for cash flow forecasting.

**Learn more:** [Cash flow forecasting - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/cash-bank-management/cash-flow-forecasting)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company sets up budget controls at the start of the year.  
  
Which three budget-control transaction actions take place when budget control is turned off in the middle of the year? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Activities are unrecorded for budget control purposes.
Budget register entries that have been posted after budget control is turned off will not be considered for budget control.
Posted documents might incorrectly reflect any relieving amounts or balances in inquiries and reports that are related to budget control.
You can view the budget reporting through financial reports.

questions.explanation:
When budget control is turned off, activities are no longer recorded for budget-control purposes and budget checks cease. Budget register entries posted while control is off are therefore not considered for budget control, and documents already posted might display incorrect relieving amounts or balances in budget-control inquiries and reports.

**Learn more:** [Budget control overview - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-control-overview-configuration)

questions.question:
You need to determine the root cause of the error that User5 is encountering.  
  
What should you review?
questions.explanation:
Fixed asset determination rules evaluate a product or procurement-category purchase against configured thresholds to determine whether it must be handled as a fixed asset. Misconfiguration of those rules can therefore prevent or incorrectly trigger fixed-asset identification during procurement. [Microsoft Learn: Product receipt against purchase orders](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/product-receipt-against-purchase-orders)\
\
**Learn more:** [Product receipt against purchase orders — Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/product-receipt-against-purchase-orders)

questions.question:
You need to determine the root cause of the error that User5 is encountering.  
  
What should you review?

options.text: Configure the Fiscal year close parameters
Configure the ledger calendar for the new fiscal year
Set up the year end close template

questions.explanation:
Year-end close preparation requires validation of each main account’s type because it controls whether its balance is carried forward or closed to retained earnings. The Fiscal year close settings in General ledger parameters control close behavior, and the enhanced year-end-close process uses a reusable year-end close template to define the legal-entity group, fiscal calendar, retained earnings accounts, and dimension handling. The ledger-calendar action for placing periods on hold is optional, and it applies to the fiscal year being closed rather than requiring a separately configured new-year ledger calendar.

**Learn more:** [Year-end close - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/year-end-close)

questions.domain: Implement and manage accounts payable and expenses
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company has configured Dynamics 365 Finance to collect and report sales tax from customers.  
  
The company calculates the sales tax amount required to pay a vendor for taxable items and expenses.  
  
The company is legally required to accrue and pay use tax. You add a new vendor in an existing region.  
  
You need to configure the system to accrue use tax for the new vendor.  
  
Which three actions should you take? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Add a tax code to the tax group with the use tax option set to Yes.
Create a new tax code for the use tax.
Create a new tax group for the use tax
Create a new settlement period for the use tax.
Create a new tax authority for the use tax
Add a tax code to the item sales tax group.

questions.explanation:
Use tax must be represented by a sales tax code marked for use tax. For tax to calculate on a vendor purchase, that code must occur in both the vendor-related sales tax group and the applicable item sales tax group; Finance determines applicable tax codes from the intersection of those two groups. An existing region can use its existing tax authority and settlement period.

**Learn more:** [Sales tax overview - Finance | Dynamics 365 | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/indirect-taxes-overview) · [Sync the tax setup from the Tax Calculation feature to Dynamics 365 Finance - Finance | Dynamics 365 | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/localizations/global/global-master-data-sync-tax-calculation-service-finance)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A legal entity operates locations and serves customers across multiple states in the United States.  
  
You need to make sure taxable customers are charged sales tax on taxable items at their delivery location.  
  
Which three settings must be configured? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: the Sales tax group on the Customer record
the Item Sales tax group on the Item record

questions.explanation:
Sales tax groups are assigned to the transaction party, such as a customer, and item sales tax groups are assigned to resources such as items. You are configuring Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
You need to implement posting definitions for every available transaction type.  
  
For which transaction types can you implement posting definitions?

options.text: Accounts payable, Accounts receivable, Bank, Budget, Payroll, and Purchasing
Accounts payable, Bank, Budget, Fixed assets, and Payroll
Accounts payable, Accounts receivable, Fixed assets, Payroll, and Purchasing
Accounts payable, Accounts receivable, Budget, and Fixed assets

questions.explanation:
Posting definitions are assigned to supported transaction types through the Transaction posting definitions page. The supported areas include Accounts payable, Accounts receivable, Bank, Budget, Payroll, and Purchasing; Fixed assets is not an available posting-definition transaction-type area.

questions.question:
A company is implementing Dynamics 365 Finance for budget control, and encumbrance accounting is enabled.  
  
The company must deduct confirmed purchase-order amounts from the available budget fund.  
  
You need to configure the available budget fund for budget control.  
  
Which configuration should be used?

options.text: Budget reservations to reduce unconfirmed encumbrances

questions.explanation: Confirmed purchase orders represent encumbrances. Enabling budget reservations for encumbrances reduces the available budget fund by the amount committed on confirmed purchase orders. Pre-encumbrance settings apply to earlier commitments, such as purchase requisitions, rather than confirmed purchase orders.

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are using Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
You need to acquire a fixed asset.  
  
Which three methods can achieve this goal? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Select a fixed asset account type and transaction type acquisition in a general journal.
Select a fixed asset procurement category on the purchase order line.
Eliminate an investment project once it is finished.

questions.explanation:
Fixed assets can be acquired through a General journal by using the Fixed assets account type and the Acquisition transaction type, or through a purchase order line configured with fixed-asset information, including a fixed asset procurement category. A completed investment project can also be estimated and eliminated to a fixed asset. Sales invoices support disposal-sale transactions, and budget plans do not post fixed-asset acquisitions.

**Learn more:** [Fixed asset transaction options - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/fixed-assets/enter-fixed-asset-transactions) · [Set up and acquire fixed assets in Dynamics 365 Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/modules/set-up-acquire-fixed-assets-finance/)

questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Finance to represent multiple business units as a financial dimension.  
  
All customer payment journals must post to the headquarters’ business-unit financial dimension.  
  
You need to configure the accounts receivable journal name.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
Default financial dimensions configured on a journal name are applied to the journal header and then default to journal lines. Therefore, setting the headquarters business-unit value as the journal name’s default financial dimension causes customer payment journals using that name to receive that business-unit value.\
\
**Learn more:** [Default financial dimensions on financial journals](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/dimensions-default-values)

A company uses Dynamics 365 Finance to represent multiple business units as a financial dimension.  
  
All customer payment journals must post to the headquarters’ business-unit financial dimension.  
  
You need to configure the accounts receivable journal name.

options.text: The budget register entry journals require both Expense and Revenue amount types.
Budget register entry line needs a main account and amount to be valid.
Budget register entry journals must be allocated across all fiscal periods.
Budget register entry lines must select only one account structure.
The budget register entries can contain either Expense or Revenue amount types.

questions.explanation:
A budget register entry line uses an account structure and financial-dimension values, including the main account, together with a budget amount. Its Amount type defaults from the selected main account type, so entries can use either an Expense or a Revenue amount type. Allocating across fiscal periods is an optional action, rather than a requirement. [Microsoft Learn: Create budget register entries](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-register-entries)

**Learn more:** [Create budget register entries - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-register-entries)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are the controller for an organization. The company purchased six service trucks. You discover that your accountant set up Fixed assets `" vehicles` in an incorrect fixed asset group.  
  
You need to achieve the following:  
  
- Change the fixed asset group so the existing fixed asset transactions for the original fixed asset are canceled and regenerated for the new fixed asset.  
- Ensure all books for the existing fixed asset are created for the new fixed asset. Any information configured for the original fixed asset is copied to the new fixed asset.  
- Close the old fixed asset number in the old fixed assets group and create a new fixed asset number in the new fixed assets group.  
- Ensure the historical transactions are transferred to the new fixed asset.  
- Ensure Historical Depreciation expense entries do not change.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Change the fixed asset group and keep the same fixed asset number

questions.explanation:
Fixed-asset reclassification transfers an asset to a new fixed asset group with a new asset number. It creates the original asset’s books on the new asset, copies its setup information, closes the original books, and cancels and regenerates the existing fixed-asset transactions for the new asset. This process transfers the asset balance and historical transactions without changing historical depreciation expense entries.

**Learn more:** [Reclassify fixed assets - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/fixed-assets/tasks/reclassify-fixed-assets)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are setting up budget control in Dynamics 365 Finance for a public sector organization.  
  
The finance team must ensure that spending is controlled against predefined budget limits and that budget checks take place during purchase requisition entry.  
  
You need to configure the system to enable budget control.  
  
Which two configurations should you perform? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Assign budget control to project categories to enforce commitment-level control.
Define budget control rules that specify which main account and financial dimensions are subject to control.
Set up budget control parameters to include source documents such as purchase requisitions.
Enable automatic budget reservation for all vendor invoice journals.

questions.explanation:
Budget control rules specify the financial dimension combinations and main accounts to which budget control applies. The Documents and journals configuration selects the source documents subject to budget checks; including purchase requisitions applies budget checking to those documents. [Budget control overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-control-overview-configuration)

**Learn more:** [Budget control overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-control-overview-configuration)

questions.question:
Solution: Modify the terms of payment.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Payment terms may be one criterion that places a sales order on credit hold, but changing them does not release all existing held orders for a customer. Held orders must be released from the credit management hold list, and changing payment terms on a customer or document does not inherently clear every hold or update the default terms on existing documents. [Credit holds for sales orders](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/cm-sales-order-credit-holds)\
\
**Learn more:** [Credit holds for sales orders](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/cm-sales-order-credit-holds) · [Establish customer payment terms](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/establish-customer-payment-terms)

questions.question:
Solution: Modify the account-status value.  
  
Does this solution achieve the goal?
questions.explanation:
A customer account status can be a condition that places sales orders on credit hold, but changing that status does not directly release the customer’s existing held orders. Existing holds must be processed through the credit-management hold list using the release process; automatic evaluation can release eligible orders only after the blocking reason is resolved.\
\
**Learn more:** [Credit holds for sales orders - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/cm-sales-order-credit-holds) · [Credit management setup - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/cm-setup-information)

questions.question:
Solution: Exclude blocking rules by using the **Release sales order** parameter.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
The **Release sales order** option is used on a Credit management exclusion rule to bypass blocking rules, so an order that meets that exclusion is not placed on hold. It is not a process for releasing sales orders that are already on hold for a specific customer. Existing holds are processed from the Credit management hold list or through the configured release workflow.\
\
**Learn more:** [Credit holds for sales orders - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/cm-sales-order-credit-holds)

questions.question:
Solution: Modify the sales order amount.  
  
Does this solution satisfy the goal?
questions.explanation:
Held sales orders are released through the Credit management hold list: select the applicable order lines, provide the required release information, and use the Release action. Changing an order amount does not release all orders on hold for a specific customer; it can only affect an amount-based blocking condition for an individual order. [Credit holds for sales orders](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/cm-sales-order-credit-holds)\
\
**Learn more:** [Credit holds for sales orders](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/cm-sales-order-credit-holds)

questions.question:
Solution: Modify the sales order amount.  
  
Does this solution satisfy the goal?
questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Finance deferral schedules use configured default accounts and templates to defer revenue, and recognition processing subsequently recognizes the scheduled amounts over time. Project deferrals support spreading project revenue across periods; assigning the fee category’s earned-revenue posting account to the project-fee deferral setup enables the fee journal to use that deferral process.

**Learn more:** [Revenue and expense deferrals in Subscription billing](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/sb-deferrals) · [TechTalk: Subscription billing and deferral schedules with project management and accounting](https://learn.microsoft.com/fr-fr/dynamics365/guidance/techtalks/finance-subscription-billing-deferral-schedules-project-management-accounting)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Solution: Set up the project ledger posting for the fee category to post to the unearned revenue account, configure an accrual scheme, and use the general journal together with that accrual scheme to recognize the unearned revenue.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Ledger accrual schemes support deferred revenue and redistribute revenue from a journal line so it is recognized in the appropriate periods. Posting the project fee to unearned revenue first, then applying the accrual scheme through a general journal, defers the warranty revenue and recognizes it over time.

**Learn more:** [Accruals overview - Finance | Dynamics 365 | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/accruals-overview) · [Create ledger accrual transactions - Finance | Dynamics 365 | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/create-ledger-accrual-transactions)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Solution: Configure the project ledger posting for the fee category so that it posts to the unearned revenue account, set up a deferral template, configure the deferral default for the general journal, and use the general journal with the deferral process to create a deferral schedule and recognize the unearned revenue from it.  
  
Does the solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Project fee transactions are posted through Project management and accounting ledger-posting rules, while general-journal deferral defaults apply when a general journal transaction uses the configured deferral account. A general-journal deferral schedule is not linked to a project fee journal transaction that has already posted to unearned revenue, so this configuration does not provide time-based recognition of that project-fee unearned revenue.

**Learn more:** [Revenue and expense deferrals in Subscription billing - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/sb-deferrals) · [How project groups, categories, and line properties determine project posting](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/project-operations/prod-pma/project-group-categories-line-properties)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
Solution: Configure the posting restriction.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A posting restriction controls which user groups are permitted to post a journal name, not which groups can select that journal name. Restricting journal-name selection requires the journal name to be made private for the appropriate user group.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create advanced rules for journals - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/create-advanced-rules-journals)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing

options.text: Validate the default item sales tax group setup for the item being sold.
Associate the sales tax jurisdiction to the item sales tax group associated to the item being sold.
Validate a default sales tax code has been set up on the customer from the sales order.
Validate the sales tax group setting on the customer from the sales order.
Validate a default item sales tax code has been set up on the item being sold.

questions.explanation:
Sales tax calculation on a sales-order line requires both a sales tax group and an item sales tax group. The customer supplies the sales tax group, the item supplies the item sales tax group, and only tax codes present in both groups apply to the transaction.

**Learn more:** [Sales tax overview - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/indirect-taxes-overview) · [Set up sales tax groups and item sales tax groups - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/set-up-sales-tax-groups-item-sales-tax-groups)

questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Finance for expense and revenue deferrals.  
  
The company requires the deferral date to fall on the first day of the month immediately following the transaction date.  
  
You need to configure the default deferral start date.  
  
Which configuration should be used?
questions.explanation:
The **Beginning of next month** default deferral start-date rule uses the first day of the following month as the deferral schedule start date. This directly implements a requirement to defer from the first day of the month immediately after the transaction date.\
\
**Learn more:** [Revenue and expense deferrals in Subscription billing - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/sb-deferrals)

questions.domain: Implement and manage accounts payable and expenses
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance. You are evaluating delinquent customers. After reviewing aging balances, you determine that a customer's balance must be written off.  
  
You need to use journal lines to complete the write-off process.  
  
Which two journal line types are created? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
A customer-balance write-off creates a line that reverses the customer balance and one or more lines that post the amount to the configured write-off account. The customer side is a customer entry, and the write-off account side is a general ledger entry.

**Learn more:** [Create a write-off journal for a customer](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/tasks/create-write-off-journal-customer)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
A company intends to allocate revenue across occurrences by using a recognition basis.  
  
Which recognition basis can be used?
questions.explanation:
A recognition basis controls how the revenue amount is allocated across occurrences. The monthly day-based basis allocates the amount using the actual days in each calendar month. “First of month” and “Mid-month split” are recognition conventions that control schedule dates, while a revenue schedule is the configuration container. Microsoft’s current terminology labels the basis “Monthly by days.”\
\
**Learn more:** [Revenue recognition setup - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/revenue-recognition-setup)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
You must configure the system to resolve User8's issue.  
  
What should you choose?

options.text: a main account in the settlement account field
a main account in the sales tax payable field

questions.explanation:
The Settlement account must contain a main account for the net balance created when sales taxes are settled, including the balance of the sales tax receivable and use tax payable ledger accounts. The Sales tax payable field is for outgoing sales tax owed to the tax authority, while standard and conditional sales tax settings control tax timing rather than the settlement account.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set up Ledger posting groups for sales tax](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/set-up-ledger-posting-groups-sales-tax)

questions.question:
A company uses the credit and collections capabilities in Dynamics 365 Finance to monitor customer invoices and incoming payments.  
  
You need to configure the automated collections task.  
  
Which two options should be configured? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Collections process automation requires a process hierarchy to assign customers and establish process precedence. Quiet days are configured to prevent the automated process from contacting a customer too frequently.\
\
**Learn more:** [Collections process automation - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/collections-process-automate)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
A company uses the credit and collections capabilities in Dynamics 365 Finance to monitor customer invoices and incoming payments.  
  
You need to configure the automated collections task.  
  
Which two options should be configured? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: a Ledger daily journal workflow that uses the organizational hierarchy for journal posting, associated with the General ledger journal name
a saved query in the Voucher inquiries form for the controller to view all general journals posted to the ledger
a manual journal approval with the journal assigned to the user group that the employees are assigned to
signing limit policies with the controller assigned to the appropriate signing limit band

questions.explanation:
A Ledger daily journal workflow configured for the applicable General ledger journal name routes journals for review and approval before posting. Workflow approval is designed to provide internal control for general journals and can use organizational hierarchy–based routing for the approver.

**Learn more:** [General journal processing - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/general-journal-processing)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],An exchange-rate provider is configured for Dynamics 365 Finance. Foreign-currency transactions that use the Euro and the US dollar use a fixed exchange rate for European Central Bank holidays and for every day from April 1 through June 30. Foreign-currency transactions from March 1 through June 30 fail to post.  
  
You need to reconfigure the system so that transactions can post for this period.  
  
Which two configuration changes should you make to the ledgers? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Add a key named FloatCurrencies and set the value to True.
Set Create necessary currency pairs to True.
Set Import as of start date to Apr01.
Add a key named BaseCurrency and value of USD.
Set Prevent import on national holiday to True.

questions.explanation:
Exchange-rate imports can be requested for a specific date range by setting an import start date. The provider configuration also needs USD as the base currency so that the required USD/EUR exchange-rate relationship is available for posting. Enabling holiday prevention would stop imports on applicable holidays rather than resolve missing rates.

**Learn more:** [Import currency exchange rates - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/import-currency-exchange-rates)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure the journal control to specify the account structure and ledger segment.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Journal control restrictions on an account structure and segment values limit which ledger-account values can be used, but they do not restrict the account type. To ensure a general journal posts only ledger-type transactions, the journal control must allow only the **Ledger** account type.\
\
**Learn more:** [General journal processing - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/general-journal-processing) · [Create advanced rules for journals - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/create-advanced-rules-journals)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure posting restrictions on the general journal.  
  
Does the solution satisfy the goal?
questions.explanation:
General-journal posting restrictions control which users or user groups may post a journal; they do not limit the types of accounts used. Restricting a journal to ledger-type transactions requires Journal control configured to allow only the Ledger account type. [Microsoft Learn: General journal processing](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/general-journal-processing)\
\
**Learn more:** [General journal processing - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/general-journal-processing) · [Create advanced rules for journals - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/create-advanced-rules-journals)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure journal control on the general journal with the account type set to Ledger.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Journal control on a general journal can restrict the account types that users can post. Allowing only the Ledger account type limits the journal to ledger-account postings, which is appropriate when the journal must be used only for ledger-type transactions.\
\
**Learn more:** [General journal processing - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/general-journal-processing)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure a default offset account on the journal name.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation: A default offset account merely prepopulates the balancing account for journal entries. It does not limit journal-line account types to Ledger, so non-ledger account types can still be posted from the general journal.

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Solution: Set up the project ledger posting for the fee category so that it posts to the unearned revenue account, create a deferral template, configure the deferral default for project fees, and recognize the unearned revenue through the deferral schedule.  
  
Does this solution achieve the goal?
questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Finance supports deferring revenue from time-and-material project fee transactions. The project group includes a Deferred revenue - fee account, correctly configured project fee transactions create deferral schedules when the invoice proposal is posted, and the deferral template and defaults determine subsequent recognition over time.

**Learn more:** [Project deferrals - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/sb-project-deferrals) · [Revenue and expense deferrals in Subscription billing - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/sb-deferrals)

questions.question:

The company requires designated user groups to be able to exceed the budget.  
  
You need to configure budget control for those user groups.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Assign budget models to budget cycles.

questions.explanation:
In Dynamics 365 Finance, **Over budget permissions** lets you specify user groups and determine whether their members can exceed the available budget, including controls related to the configured budget threshold.\
\
**Learn more:** [Budget control overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-control-overview-configuration)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A customer uses the sales tax functionality in Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
The customer reports that sales tax is not calculated on a line when a sales order is created.  
  
You need to determine why sales tax is not being calculated.  
  
What are two possible reasons? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: The sales tax group is populated on the line, but the item sales tax group is missing.
The sales tax settlement account is not configured correctly.
The sales tax authority is not set up for the correct jurisdiction.
The sales tax code and item sales tax code are selected, but the sales tax group is not associated to both codes.
The sales tax group and item sales tax group are selected, but the sales tax code is not associated with both groups.

questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Finance can calculate sales tax only when both a sales tax group and an item sales tax group are present on the transaction. The applicable tax codes are those included in both groups. Consequently, a missing item sales tax group, or the absence of a sales tax code common to both groups, results in no sales tax being calculated.

**Learn more:** [Sales tax overview - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/indirect-taxes-overview) · [Set up sales tax groups and item sales tax groups - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/set-up-sales-tax-groups-item-sales-tax-groups)

questions.question:
You need to set up the posting groups for Humongous Insurance's subsidiary.  
  
Which ledger posting-group field should you use?
questions.explanation:
The Sales tax payable field specifies the main account for outgoing sales taxes collected on taxable sales and owed to the tax authority. It is the standard ledger-posting-group field for posting sales-tax liabilities.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set up Ledger posting groups for sales tax](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/set-up-ledger-posting-groups-sales-tax)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
You need to set up the posting groups for Humongous Insurance's subsidiary.  
  
Which ledger posting-group field should you use?

options.text: Assign values to the sales tax codes and assign the sales tax codes to the sales tax group associated to the customer.
Assign all sales tax codes to the item sales tax group associated to the item being sold.
Set up a default item sales tax group on the item being sold and set up a default sales tax group on the customer used on the sales order.
Associate the sales tax jurisdictions to the item sales tax group associated to the item being sold.
Set up a default sales tax code on the customer used on the sales order and set up a default item sales tax group on the item being sold.

questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Finance calculates sales tax only when a transaction has both a sales tax group and an item sales tax group. Default groups on the customer and item populate the sales order, and the applicable tax codes are the intersection of the sales tax codes assigned to those two groups. Sales tax codes also require configured values, such as rates and calculation rules.

**Learn more:** [Sales tax overview - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/indirect-taxes-overview) · [Set up sales tax groups and item sales tax groups - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/tasks/set-up-sales-tax-groups-item-sales-tax-groups)

A company uses Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
You must configure credit holds for sales orders.  
  
Which three options can be used to set up blocking rules? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Finance Credit management blocking rules can place sales orders on hold based on the number of days overdue, credit-limit expiration, and payment terms. Risk groups and customer groups are criteria for restricting the customers affected by a rule, rather than independent blocking-rule types.\
\
**Learn more:** [Credit holds for sales orders - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/cm-sales-order-credit-holds)

questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Finance for budget management.  
  
You need to reallocate funds during the year.  
  
Which budget code should be used?
questions.explanation:
A budget code associated with the **Transfer** budget type is used to move budget funds during the fiscal year: the source financial dimension is reduced and the destination financial dimension is increased by the same amount.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create budget register entries - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-register-entries)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A client uses Dynamics 365 Finance for accounts receivable.  
  
You need to configure the method of payment so that the accounts receivable clerk must enter the wire number for a received electronic payment.  
  
Which item should be configured as mandatory?
questions.explanation:
A wire number is the reference for a received electronic payment, so the Payment reference field must be mandatory. The method-of-payment Payment control settings define mandatory payment fields. Microsoft documents that a payment reference can be a reference from an electronic payment.

**Learn more:** [Establish customer method of payment - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/uk-ua/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/tasks/establish-customer-method-payment) · [Customer payment overview - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/cash-bank-management/tasks/customer-payment-overview)

The company must be able to:  
  
- Set up default accounts and templates for the deferral schedule.  
- View and edit the deferral schedule.  
  
You need to configure subscription billing.  
  
Which configurations should you use? You may use each configuration once, more than once, or not at all.

<DragDrop
  items={["Deferral defaults","Deferral templates","All deferral schedules","Revenue and expense deferral parameters"]}

/>","className":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Finance to manage project billing and expenses. Team members complete expense reports and submit them to a project manager for approval.  
  
Each expense report must include expense lines for only one project. Expense reports submitted without a project specified must be rejected.  
  
You need to configure an expense report approval workflow.  
  
Which three actions should you take? Each correct answer is part of the solution.  
  
> NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Create an expenditure reviewers' group in Expense management.
Create a user group for project managers and add all project managers to the group.
Set up a condition to run an approval step only if the expense report has a project specified. Set the workflow assignment to Expenditure reviewers.
Set up an automatic action to reject expense report lines that do not have projects specified. Set the workflow assignment to Expenditure reviewers.

questions.explanation:
Expense report expenditure reviewers can be configured using project distributions, including the project manager project authority, so the workflow can route approval dynamically to the manager of the project on the expense line. An expense report workflow is required to process the submission. An automatic workflow action that rejects expense report lines with no specified project enforces the mandatory-project requirement. A condition that only executes approval when a project exists would skip approval for missing-project submissions rather than reject them.

**Learn more:** [Configure expenditure reviewers - Finance & Operations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/fin-ops-core/fin-ops/organization-administration/configure-expenditure-reviewers) · [Configure approval steps in a workflow - Finance & Operations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/fin-ops-core/fin-ops/organization-administration/configure-approval-step-workflow)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A cable and internet company is implementing Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
The company’s primary line of business is internet services. It also sells routers and modems to customers for an additional one-time cost.  
  
You need to configure revenue recognition.  
  
What should you configure?

options.text: Create a revenue schedule for the internet service, router, and modem.
Configure the internet service as essential.
Configure the internet service, router, and modem as essential.
Create the router and modem sales to post to deferred revenue.

questions.explanation:
An essential item is a primary source of an organization’s revenue. Internet service meets that definition, whereas routers and modems are one-time hardware sales. Revenue is deferred only when a sales-order line has a revenue schedule; without one, hardware revenue is posted when invoiced. [Revenue recognition overview — Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/revenue-recognition-overview)

**Learn more:** [Revenue recognition overview — Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/revenue-recognition-overview) · [Revenue recognition on sales orders — Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-receivable/revenue-recognition-so-basics)

questions.domain: Implement and manage accounts payable and expenses
questions.question:
A customer uses the bank reconciliation functionality in Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
The customer identifies a transaction in a closed fiscal period that needs correction.  
  
You need to correct this transaction.  
  
How should you make the correction?

options.text: Create a new line for the transaction in the closed period.
Create a new line for the transaction in an open period.

questions.explanation:
For a bank reconciliation transaction whose fiscal period is closed, the Correction amount field cannot be used. The correction must be entered as a new line with a transaction date in an open fiscal period; it should use the financial dimensions from the original transaction and the offset main account.\
\
**Learn more:** [Reconcile a bank account - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/cash-bank-management/reconcile-bank-account)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
You need to configure CustomerX’s fiscal calendar for financial reporting.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Use the ledger calendar to set up the 4-5-4 calendar.
Configure the fiscal calendar to include a 13 th closing period.
Configure the ledger calendar to include a 13 th closing period.
Use the closing period adjustments form.

questions.explanation:
A fiscal calendar defines the fiscal periods used for reporting. For a 12-period fiscal year, the closing period is typically period 13; it should be created in the fiscal calendar so closing entries can be reported separately from regular-period transactions.\
\
**Learn more:** [Fiscal calendars, fiscal years, and periods - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/fiscal-calendars-fiscal-years-periods)

questions.domain: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
questions.question:
You need to configure CustomerX’s fiscal calendar for financial reporting.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Specify user groups with permissions to exceed the budget.
Define the calculation formula for budget funds available, including draft documents.
Assign budget models to the budget cycle time spans.

questions.explanation:
Budget models hold the budget amounts used by budget control. Assigning a budget model to the applicable budget cycle time span includes that model in budget control, enabling expenditure checks against the corresponding budget balances.

**Learn more:** [Budget control overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-control-overview-configuration)

questions.domain: Implement and manage accounts payable and expenses
questions.question:
You must configure budget planning for Alpine Ski House Corporate.  
  
Which two components should you configure? Each correct answer forms part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Budget planning uses a budget planning hierarchy to aggregate and distribute budget data across responsibility centers. It also uses budget planning workflows, together with budgeting workflows, to define stages and route budget plans for review and approval.\
\
**Learn more:** [Budget planning overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/budget-planning-overview-configuration)

questions.question:
Solution: Choose **Consolidate with import**.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Consolidate with import is for bringing balances into a consolidation company from a different database, Finance instance, or external source. When all legal entities and data are in the same Dynamics 365 Finance instance, Consolidate online is the applicable consolidation method and supports consolidations involving eliminations.\
\

questions.question:
Solution: Choose **Consolidate online** in Dynamics 365 Finance. Include eliminations during the process or through a proposal. Configure the transactions to post to the legal entity set up for consolidations.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Finance supports online consolidation for legal entities in the same Finance environment. Eliminations can be included in the consolidation process or generated through an elimination proposal, and the resulting transactions are posted to the consolidation company.\
\
**Learn more:** [Consolidation and elimination overview - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/consolidation-elimination-overview) · [Elimination rules - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/elimination-rules)

questions.question:
Solution: Create a separate company where you manually create the eliminations. Then use that company in Financial reporting or in the consolidation process.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Finance supports creating a separate company to manually determine and post elimination transactions, and that company can be used in the consolidation process or in Financial reporting.\
\
**Learn more:** [Consolidation and elimination overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/budgeting/consolidation-elimination-overview)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure elimination rules in the system. Then run an elimination proposal. Set the rules to post to any company that has **Use for financial elimination process** selected in the legal entity setup.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Finance can perform financial eliminations by using elimination rules and processing them through an elimination proposal. Elimination rules can post to any legal entity configured with **Use for financial elimination process** in legal entity setup.\
